111422.name: Firewall
desc: Create a wall of fire, dealing {val1}% Burning damage over 3.5 seconds. Enemies continue Burning for 1.8 seconds after leaving the wall.

2686060761.name: Healing
2686060761.desc: Firewall heals you for 0.3% of your Maximum Life (0) every second per affected enemy.  Every 15 Life healed by Firewall grants you 1 stack of Overpower.

2686060762.name: Damage Bonus
2686060762.desc: Firewall deals 75%[x] increased damage, but its duration is reduced by 25%.

2686060763.name: Weaken
2686060763.desc: Firewall Weakens enemies for 2 seconds.

2686060764.name: Cost Reduction
2686060764.desc: Every 100 Mana spent makes your next Firewall cost no Mana, stacking up to 300 total Mana.

2686060809.name: Wildfire
2686060809.desc: Firewall's Size is increased by 50% and duration increased to 7.0 seconds.

2686060810.name: Ring of Fire
2686060810.desc: Firewall creates a ring of fire that deals 300% Fire damage over 3.5 seconds, but it now has a 12 second Cooldown.  Standing in this ring causes your Direct Damage from Pyromancy Skills to inflict this Burning damage to enemies.

2686060811.name: Grounding
2686060811.desc: Firewall becomes a Shock Skill, deals 150% Sparking damage over 3.5 seconds, and costs 30 Mana.  Lucky Hit: Up to a 25% chance to deal 300% damage and form a Crackling Energy against enemies affected by Firewall.

143483.name: Spark
desc: Launch a bolt of lightning that shocks an enemy 3 times, dealing {val1}% damage with each shock.

2686060761.name: Additional Hits
2686060761.desc: Spark shocks 1 additional time.

2686060762.name: Crackling Energy
2686060762.desc: Spark forms a Crackling Energy the first time it damages a target.

2686060763.name: Additional Hits
2686060763.desc: Spark shocks 1 additional time.

2686060764.name: Critical Strike Chance
2686060764.desc: Spark gains 10% Critical Strike Chance.

2686060809.name: Overcharged
2686060809.desc: Spark shocks 4 additional times. Each time a shock does not Critically Strike it gains 10% Critical Strike Chance.

2686060810.name: Electric Blast
2686060810.desc: Spark combines all shocks into one blast in an area, dealing 50%[x] increased damage and gaining 25% increased Size per shock.

2686060811.name: Firework
2686060811.desc: Spark becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals Fire damage.  Spark shocks now explode, dealing 45% damage that gain 25%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage.

146743.name: Hydra
desc: Summon a 3-headed Hydra for 10.0 seconds. Each head spits fire at enemies, dealing {val1}% damage.
You may have up to 1 Hydra active at a time.

2686060761.name: Healing
2686060761.desc: Hydra heals you for 1% of your Maximum Life (1) each time it deals damage.

2686060762.name: Overpower
2686060762.desc: Hydra gains 1 head for every 3 Overpower you have on Cast.

2686060763.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060763.desc: Hydra reduces the Cooldown of a random Skill by 0.3 seconds whenever it attacks.

2686060764.name: Cast Speed
2686060764.desc: Hydra gains 50% Cast Speed, but its duration is reduced to 8 seconds.

2686060809.name: Bathed in Flame
2686060809.desc: Hydra is bathed in flame, dealing 28% Burning damage per second to surrounding enemies.  Hydra's attacks now instead deal 70% Burning damage over 4 seconds.

2686060810.name: Behemoth
2686060810.desc: Hydra Summons a massive 1-headed Hydra that spits explosive fire and deals 20% increased damage for each extra head it would have had.  Hydra no longer costs Mana, but has a 15 second Cooldown. You can now have up to 10 total Hydras at one time.

2686060811.name: Frigid Hydra
2686060811.desc: Hydra becomes a Frost Skill that deals 61.25% Cold damage.  Hydra's attacks pierce enemies and Chill for 15%.

153249.name: Fire Bolt
desc: Hurl a flaming bolt, dealing {val1}% damage and an additional {val2}% Burning damage over 6 seconds.

2686060761.name: Healing
2686060761.desc: Fire Bolt heals you for 2% of your Maximum Life (2) when it hits the first enemy.

2686060762.name: Resource Generation
2686060762.desc: Fire Bolt generates 2 Mana when it hits the first enemy, or 4 Mana if the enemy is already Burning.

2686060763.name: Damage Bonus
2686060763.desc: Fire Bolt deals 50%[x] increased Burning damage.

2686060764.name: Overpower
2686060764.desc: Fire Bolt grants 1 stack of Overpower.

2686060809.name: Twin Flame
2686060809.desc: Fire Bolt launches an additional parallel bolt, dealing 18% Fire damage.

2686060810.name: Firefly
2686060810.desc: Fire Bolt shoots out a firefly that attaches itself to an enemy and explodes 3 times after a delay, dealing 25.2% damage with each explosion.

2686060811.name: Shiver
2686060811.desc: Fire Bolt becomes a Frost Skill, dealing 27% Cold damage and 180% Frostbite damage over 6 seconds.  Fire Bolt pierces 1 time and makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

165023.name: Fireball
desc: Hurl an exploding ball of fire, dealing {val1}% damage to enemies.

2686060761.name: Critical Strike Damage
2686060761.desc: Fireball deals 30%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage.

2686060762.name: Damage Over Time
2686060762.desc: Fireball's direct damage deals an additional 30% damage over 4 seconds.

2686060763.name: Damage Bonus
2686060763.desc: Fireball deals 40%[x] increased damage, but its Mana cost is increased by 15.

2686060764.name: Size Bonus
2686060764.desc: Fireball's Size is increased by 50%.

2686060809.name: Instantaneous Destruction
2686060809.desc: Fireball travels 200% faster and deals 75%[x] increased damage.

2686060810.name: Illumination
2686060810.desc: Fireball now bounces as it travels and explodes each time it hits the ground, dealing 75% of normal damage.

2686060811.name: Frostball
2686060811.desc: Fireball becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage.  When Fireball hits an enemy it creates 3 Ice Spikes around them, dealing 85% damage each.

167341.name: Flame Shield
desc: Engulf yourself in flames for 1.0 seconds, becoming Immune and dealing {val1}% Burning damage over 4 seconds to surrounding enemies.

2686060761.name: Healing
2686060761.desc: While Flame Shield is active, you heal for 12% of your Maximum Life (12) per second.

2686060762.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060762.desc: Flame Shield's Cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.

2686060763.name: Duration Bonus
2686060763.desc: Flame Shield's duration is increased to 1.5 seconds.

2686060764.name: Overpower
2686060764.desc: Flame Shield grants 1 stack of Overpower.

2686060809.name: Scorch
2686060809.desc: Flame Shield instantly scorches close enemies, dealing 14% damage and Immobilizing them for 3 seconds.

2686060810.name: Firebird
2686060810.desc: Flame Shield rains down 4 Meteorites per second that deal 8.5% damage.

2686060811.name: Flash
2686060811.desc: Flame Shield becomes a Shock Skill, deals Sparking damage, and triggers its Cooldown on Cast.  Instead of becoming Immune you embody lightning, generating 4 Crackling Energy per second and gaining 35%[x] Movement Speed and 15.0% Dodge.

171937.name: Charged Bolts
desc: Release 3 bolts of piercing lightning that course along the ground, dealing {val1}% damage each.

2686060761.name: Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Charged Bolts deals 15%[x] increased damage to Close enemies.  Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt.

2686060762.name: Weaken
2686060762.desc: Charged Bolts Weakens enemies for 6 seconds.  Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt.

2686060763.name: Cast Speed
2686060763.desc: Each time you cast Charged Bolts it gains 5% Cast Speed, up to 15%. Moving removes this effect.  Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt.

2686060764.name: Movement Speed
2686060764.desc: Each time you cast Charged Bolts it gains 4%[x] bolt speed and you gain 4% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, up to 20%[x].  Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt.

2686060809.name: Surging Charge
2686060809.desc: Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt, plus 1 additional bolt per stack of Ferocity.

2686060810.name: Overload
2686060810.desc: Casting Charged Bolts now also discharges Crackling Energy in an electric wave, dealing its damage to all enemies caught in it.  Crackling Energy will no longer automatically pulse its last 3 charges.

2686060811.name: Burn Through
2686060811.desc: Charged Bolts becomes a Pyromancy Skill, deals Fire damage, and costs 30 Mana.  Each bolt no longer pierces and instead releases 2 to 3 explosions on impact, dealing an additional 180% damage.

184600.name: War Cry
desc: Bellow a mighty war cry, increasing your damage dealt by {val1}%[x] for 4.0 seconds.
Nearby allies gain half of War Cry's effects.

2686060761.name: Ferocity
2686060761.desc: War Cry grants 2 stacks of Ferocity.

2686060762.name: Slow
2686060762.desc: War Cry Slows nearby enemies by 20% for 4 seconds.

2686060763.name: Duration Increase
2686060763.desc: War Cry's duration is increased to 6 seconds.

2686060764.name: Vulnerable
2686060764.desc: War Cry makes nearby enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

2686060809.name: Mighty Roar
2686060809.desc: War Cry's damage bonus is increased by 10% and allies now receive its full effect. You also gain Berserking for 4 seconds.

2686060810.name: Korlic
2686060810.desc: War Cry Summons Korlic who leaps at enemies, dealing 110% damage

2686060811.name: The Scream
2686060811.desc: War Cry terrifies your enemies, causing them to cower in Fear. You gain 0.300%[x] increased damage for each enemy Feared, up to 3.00%[x]

186358.name: Ground Stomp
desc: Smash the ground, dealing {val1}% damage and Stunning surrounding enemies for 3 seconds.

2686060761.name: Fury Generation
2686060761.desc: Increases the Fury generated by Ground Stomp to 30.

2686060762.name: Additional Charges
2686060762.desc: Ground Stomp gains 2 additional Charges.

2686060763.name: Size Bonus
2686060763.desc: Ground Stomp gains 20% increased Size.

2686060764.name: Damage Bonus
2686060764.desc: Ground Stomp deals 20%[x] increased damage.

2686060809.name: Stomping Grounds
2686060809.desc: Casting Ground Stomp also causes your steps to echo additional Ground Stomps dealing 12.5% damage as you travel for 3 seconds

2686060810.name: Seismic
2686060810.desc: Ground Stomp no longer Stuns and instead creates an Earthquake that deals 150% damage and Slows enemies by 75%.

2686060811.name: Breach
2686060811.desc: Ground Stomp becomes a Brawling Skill that deals Fire damage.  Ground Stomp no longer Stuns and smashes the surrounding ground. Instead, it fissures the ground in front of you, dealing 150% damage. Burning enemies take 20%[x] increased damage.

196545.name: Leap
desc: Leap forward and then slam down, dealing {val1}% damage and Slowing enemies by 70% for 3 seconds.

2686060761.name: Arsenal Bonus
2686060761.desc: Leap grants a bonus based on its Arsenal Selection Dual Wield: 2 seconds of Berserking Bludgeoning: 1 stack of Overpower Slashing: 1 stack of Ferocity

2686060762.name: Fury Generation
2686060762.desc: Leap now generates 20 Fury.

2686060763.name: Pull
2686060763.desc: Leap now Pulls In enemies upon landing.

2686060764.name: Damage Bonus and Crowd Control
2686060764.desc: Leap deals 20%[x] increased damage and Knocks Down enemies for 1 second.

2686060809.name: Death From Above
2686060809.desc: Leap's Size and damage are increased the further you Leap, up to 30% increased Size and 96.25% damage.

2686060810.name: Earthshatter
2686060810.desc: Leap now deals 19.25% damage and can be Cast again within 2 seconds before the Cooldown begins.  Landing creates an Earthquake that deals 77% Physical damage over 4 seconds.

2686060811.name: Mosh
2686060811.desc: Leap Summons 3 Ancients that Leap at a random enemy and deal 13.75% damage.

199516.name: Kick
desc: Throw a powerful kick that deals {val1}% damage and Knocks Back enemies in front of you. Enemies who are Knocked Back into terrain take an additional {val2}% damage and are Stunned for 3 seconds.

2686060761.name: Increase Damage
2686060761.desc: Moving increases Kick's damage by up to 20%[x].

2686060762.name: Vulnerable
2686060762.desc: Kick makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

2686060763.name: Collide
2686060763.desc: Kicked enemies deal 20% damage to enemies they collide with. Additionally, Kick destroys certain objects from Elite monster affixes.

2686060764.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060764.desc: Kicking an enemy reduces the Cooldowns of your Mobility Skills by 2 seconds.

2686060809.name: Power
2686060809.desc: Instead of Knocking Back enemies, Kick becomes a Core Skill which costs 30 Fury and deals 100% damage, increased by 0.5%[x] per Maximum Fury you have, up to 150 Fury.

2686060810.name: Crimson
2686060810.desc: Kick now deals 25% Fire damage and inflicts 25% Burning damage over 4 seconds. Burning enemies will explode on Death or if they hit a wall for 75% damage.

2686060811.name: Madness
2686060811.desc: You dash towards your enemy and deliver a powerful kick that deals 175% and Knocks Down enemies for 4 seconds.  Kick is additionally a Mobility Skill.

200765.name: Bash
desc: Bash the enemy with your weapon, dealing {val1}% damage.
Every [5th Bash will clobber, Stunning enemies for 1.5 seconds.

2686060761.name: Resolve
2686060761.desc: Clobbering with Bash grants 1 stack of Resolve.

2686060762.name: Clobbering
2686060762.desc: Reduces Bash's Clobber threshold by 2.

2686060763.name: Overpower
2686060763.desc: Clobbering with Bash grants 1 stack of Overpower.

2686060764.name: Fury Generation
2686060764.desc: Clobbering with Bash generates an additional 10 Fury.

2686060809.name: Heavy Knuckles
2686060809.desc: Clobbering an enemy with Bash has a 100% chance to Critical Strike, and Clobbered enemies become Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

2686060810.name: Violent Swings
2686060810.desc: Each Bash has a separate 25% chance to clobber.

2686060811.name: Atomic Blast
2686060811.desc: Clobbering an enemy with Bash causes a fiery explosion that deals 112.5% Fire damage.

202484.name: Upheaval
desc: Tear into the ground with your weapon and fling debris forward, dealing {val1}% damage.

2686060761.name: Damage Increase
2686060761.desc: Upheaval deals 30%[x] increased damage to the first 5 enemies hit.

2686060762.name: Fury Cost Reduction
2686060762.desc: Upheaval's Fury cost is reduced to 28 Fury.

2686060763.name: Overpower
2686060763.desc: Upheaval consumes 1 Overpower stack to increase Upheaval's Size by 20% and damage by 20%[x].

2686060764.name: Free Cast
2686060764.desc: Every 100 Fury spent makes your next Upheaval free to cast. This stacks up to 300 total Fury.

2686060809.name: Trailblazing
2686060809.desc: Upheaval ignites the ground Burning enemies for an additional 150% damage over 4 seconds.  Upheaval now deals Fire damage.

2686060810.name: Iron Burst
2686060810.desc: Upheaval flings Iron Shrapnel dealing 37.5% damage, and inflicting 150% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

2686060811.name: Suppress
2686060811.desc: Upheaval gains deals 75%[x] increased damage. Depending on the cast range, this area increases but the damage bonus decreases.

204662.name: Charge
desc: Rush forward and push enemies before swinging your weapon, dealing {val1}% damage and Knocking Back enemies.

2686060761.name: Unstoppable
2686060761.desc: You are Unstoppable during Charge.

2686060762.name: Distance Damage Bonus
2686060762.desc: Charge deals up to 22%[x] increased damage based on distance traveled.

2686060763.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060763.desc: Charge's Cooldown is reduced by 1 second for each enemy it hit, up to 3.

2686060764.name: Enemy Damage Bonus
2686060764.desc: Charge deals 5%[x] increased damage per enemy pushed, up to 20%[x].

2686060809.name: Merciless Assault
2686060809.desc: Charge gains 3 Charges, and all of its Charges are refreshed on Cooldown.

2686060810.name: Phalanx
2686060810.desc: Charge Summons 2 Ancients to Charge with you and swing for 67.5% damage.

2686060811.name: Battering Ram
2686060811.desc: Charge now deals Fire damage.  Instead of swinging your weapon, colliding with enemies deals 63% Fire damage and Stuns them for 3 seconds. Additionally, you leave a burning trail that inflicts 252% Burning damage over 3 seconds.

206435.name: Whirlwind
desc: Rapidly attack surrounding enemies for {val1}% damage.

2686060761.name: Movement Speed
2686060761.desc: Gain 12%[x] increased Movement Speed during Whirlwind.

2686060762.name: Cost Damage Bonus
2686060762.desc: Whirlwind deals 40%[x] increased damage and costs 10 additional Fury.

2686060763.name: Channel Damage Bonus
2686060763.desc: Channeling Whirlwind causes it to deal 1%[x] increased damage each time it hits an enemy, stacking up to 25 times.

2686060764.name: Weaken
2686060764.desc: Critical Strikes from Whirlwind Weaken enemies for 4 seconds.

2686060809.name: Tornado
2686060809.desc: Whirlwind also creates 2 Dust Devils that each deal 61.87% damage.

2686060810.name: Bursting
2686060810.desc: Whirlwind also explodes, dealing 17.88% Fire damage and inflicting 50% Burning damage over 5 seconds.  Whirlwind now deals Fire damage.

2686060811.name: Winding
2686060811.desc: Attacking with another Skill grants 4 stacks of charge up to 20 that decays over time. Your Whirlwind deals 1%[x] increased damage and gains 1%[x] Movement Speed per stack.  While Whirlwind has charges it launches Iron Shrapnel at Nearby enemies, each dealing 16.5% damage and inflicting 13.75% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

206504.name: Lunging Strike
desc: Lunge forward and strike an enemy, dealing {val1}% damage.

2686060761.name: Range
2686060761.desc: Lunging Strike's range is increased by 2.

2686060762.name: Fury Generation
2686060762.desc: Lunging Strike generates 1 Fury for each enemy you lunge through.

2686060763.name: Healing
2686060763.desc: Lunging Strike heals you for 2% of your Maximum Life (2) the first time it hits an enemy.

2686060764.name: Berserking
2686060764.desc: Lunging Strike grants Berserking for 3 seconds when it Critically Strikes.  Lunging Strike gains 5% increased Critical Strike Chance.

2686060809.name: Skewer
2686060809.desc: Lunging Strike deals 75%[x] increased damage and an additional 5%[x] increased damage for each target you lunge through, up to 100%[x].

2686060810.name: Impaling
2686060810.desc: Lunging Strike has increased range, damages all enemies in its path, and can lunge without a target.  Lunging Strike now has a 2 second Cooldown.

2686060811.name: Whirling
2686060811.desc: Lunging Strike forms a Dust Devil that deals 22.5% damage.

208000.name: Double Swing
desc: Sweep your weapons from opposite directions, dealing {val1}% damage with each weapon. Enemies caught in the center are damaged by both.

2686060761.name: Chance to Hit Twice
2686060761.desc: Gains 20% chance to hit twice.

2686060762.name: Fortify
2686060762.desc: Fortifies you for 1% of your Maximum Life for each enemy hit with both weapons.

2686060763.name: Damage Increase
2686060763.desc: Increases this Skill's damage by 2%[x] per enemy hit for 2 seconds, all stacks expire simultaneously and the duration cannot be refreshed.

2686060764.name: Fury Cost Reduction
2686060764.desc: Decreases the Fury Cost of your next Double Swing per hit by 2 once per weapon.

2686060809.name: Flurry
2686060809.desc: Each sweep also hits 1 additional time dealing 37.5%, and an extra 2 additional times while Berserking.

2686060810.name: Twister
2686060810.desc: The initial sweep also creates 1 Dust Devil that deals 37.5% damage, the subsequent sweep creates 2.

2686060811.name: Slice and Dice
2686060811.desc: Sweep Size increased by 200% but Cast Speed is slowed by 40%. Enemies caught at the outer edge of your sweeps and are hit an additional time for 90% damage.  These additional hits grant this Skill 5% increased Cast Speed for 4 seconds, stacking up to 8 times.

210431.name: Flay
desc: Flay the enemy, dealing {val1}% damage and inflicting {val2}% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

2686060761.name: Slow
2686060761.desc: Flay Slows enemies by 20%.

2686060762.name: Duration Bonus
2686060762.desc: Flay's Bleeding duration is increased by 5 seconds.

2686060763.name: Weaken
2686060763.desc: Flay Weakens enemies.

2686060764.name: Healing
2686060764.desc: Each Nearby enemy Bleeding from Flay Heals you for 1% of your Maximum Life (1) per second, up to 5%.

2686060809.name: Anemia
2686060809.desc: Flay's Bleeding duration is reduced by 2 seconds and it makes enemies Vulnerable.

2686060810.name: Hemorrhaging
2686060810.desc: Flay's Bleeding is extended by 2 seconds whenever the enemy moves too far from you.

2686060811.name: The Flayer
2686060811.desc: If Flay hits a Bleeding enemy it causes a blood explosion that inflicts 28.75% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

210919.name: Frenzy
desc: Unleash a rapid flurry of blows, dealing {val1}% damage with each pair of hits.
If Frenzy hits an enemy, its Cast Speed is increased by 10% for 3 seconds, up to 50%.

2686060761.name: Ferocity
2686060761.desc: Each stack of Frenzy gained also grants a stack of Ferocity.

2686060762.name: Unhindered
2686060762.desc: While at maximum Frenzy stacks, you are Unhindered.

2686060763.name: Frenzy Stacks
2686060763.desc: Frenzy stacks an additional 2 times.

2686060764.name: Fury Generation
2686060764.desc: Frenzy generates 2 additional Fury.

2686060809.name: Barrage
2686060809.desc: Frenzy stacks up an additional 5 times and you gain Berserking for 5 seconds while at maximum stacks.

2686060810.name: Throwing
2686060810.desc: Frenzy becomes a ranged attack that pierces enemies, dealing 122.5% damage.  Frenzy has a 30% chance while at maximum Frenzy stacks to ricochet Iron Shrapnel, dealing 59.5% damage and inflicting 35% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

2686060811.name: Raging
2686060811.desc: Frenzy now deals Fire damage.  Lucky Hit: Frenzy has up to a 75% chance to cause a fiery explosion, dealing 175% Burning damage over 5 seconds.

211871.name: Wrath of the Berserker
desc: Explode into rage, Knocking Back surrounding enemies while gaining 30%[x] increased damage, Berserking, and Unstoppable for {val1} seconds.

2686060761.name: Fury Generation
2686060761.desc: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, gain 20% Attack Speed and increase Fury Generation by 30%[x].

2686060762.name: Berserking
2686060762.desc: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, your Berserking's base damage bonus is doubled.

2686060763.name: Duration Bonus
2686060763.desc: The duration of Wrath of the Berserker is increased to 12.0 seconds.

2686060764.name: Overpower
2686060764.desc: Wrath of the Berserker grants 1 stack of Overpower per second.

2686060809.name: Maximum Carnage
2686060809.desc: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, every 200 Fury spent increases its duration by 1 second, up to 5.

2686060810.name: Deep Impact
2686060810.desc: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, all attacks causes a fiery explosion for 75% damage.

2686060811.name: Full Throttle
2686060811.desc: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, you gain a Fire aura that deals 100% damage and Burns for 10% damage over 5 seconds. You gain 50% All Resistance.

211938.name: Rallying Cry
desc: Bellow a rallying cry, increasing your Movement Speed by {val1}%[x] for 4.0 seconds.
Nearby allies gain half of Rallying Cry's effects.

2686060761.name: Fortify
2686060761.desc: Rallying Cry Fortifies you for 15% of your Maximum Life when cast.

2686060762.name: Duration Bonus
2686060762.desc: Rallying Cry's duration is increased to 7 seconds.

2686060763.name: Fury Gain
2686060763.desc: For every 3 meter traveled while Rallying Cry is active, restore 2 primary resource to yourself and half to nearby allies.

2686060764.name: Potency
2686060764.desc: Rallying Cry's effectiveness is increased by 20% plus an additional 5% for each ally affected, up to 20%.

2686060809.name: Booming
2686060809.desc: Rallying Cry increases your Resource Generation by 40%[x] and your Movement Speed by an additional 10%[x].

2686060810.name: Madawc
2686060810.desc: Rallying Cry's Fury Cost is reduced by 10 and it now Summons Madawc who upheaves the ground, dealing 100% damage.

2686060811.name: The World
2686060811.desc: Rallying Cry Dazes and Slows all enemies and their projectiles by 61% for 4 seconds.  Rallying Cry also grants Attack Speed instead of Movement Speed and its Fury Cost is replaced with a 25 second Cooldown.

213673.name: Hammer of the Ancients
desc: Slam your hammer down with the fury of the Ancients, dealing {val1}% damage to a concentrated area.

2686060761.name: Critical Strike
2686060761.desc: Hammer of the Ancients gains 2% increased Critical Strike Chance for every 20 Maximum Fury you have, up to 20% Critical Strike Chance at 200 Maximum Fury.  Current bonus: 0% increased Critical Strike Chance.

2686060762.name: Size and Damage Bonus
2686060762.desc: Hammer of the Ancients gains 25% increased Size and 20%[x] increased damage.

2686060763.name: Fury Generation
2686060763.desc: Gain 3% increased Fury Generation for 5 seconds for each enemy damaged by Hammer of the Ancients, up to 30%.

2686060764.name: Overpower
2686060764.desc: Hammer of the Ancients deals 20%[x] increased damage if you have Overpower.

2686060809.name: Explosive
2686060809.desc: Hammer of the Ancients quakes outward and deals 280% damage.

2686060810.name: Fissure
2686060810.desc: Hammer of the Ancients forms a seismic line that deals 280% and Slows enemies hit by 80% for 4 seconds.

2686060811.name: Ancestral
2686060811.desc: Hammer of the Ancients now deals Fire damage.  Casting Hammer of the Ancients Summons 2 Ancients to hammer the same area for 66.5% damage each. If Burning enemies are struck Hammer of the Ancients explodes, dealing 17.5% damage.

214786.name: Rend
desc: Cleave enemies in front of you, dealing {val1}% damage and inflicting {val2}% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

2686060761.name: Moving Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Rend deals 25%[x] increased damage to enemies that are moving.

2686060762.name: Vulnerable Damage Bonus
2686060762.desc: Rend deals 20%[x] increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.

2686060763.name: Cast Speed
2686060763.desc: Rend gains 20% increased Cast Speed.

2686060764.name: Healing
2686060764.desc: Heal for 1% of your Maximum Life per second for each enemy Bleeding from Rend.

2686060809.name: Flailing
2686060809.desc: Rend gains 40% increased Size and 40%[x] increased damage. Consecutive swings of Rend further increases its Size by 20%, up to 60%, until you stop swinging.

2686060810.name: Blood Sworn
2686060810.desc: Enemies that die while Bleeding from Rend spread 50% their remaining Bleed onto a random Close enemy.

2686060811.name: Scorching
2686060811.desc: Rend now deals Fire damage.  Each slash creates a wave of fire, dealing 43.75% damage and an additional 189% Burning damage over 5 seconds.

215027.name: Rupture
desc: Skewer enemies in front of you, dealing {val1}% damage, then rip your weapon out, inflicting {val2}% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

2686060761.name: Size Bonus
2686060761.desc: Rupture's Size is increased by 25%.

2686060762.name: Damage Bonus
2686060762.desc: Rupture deals 25%[x] increased damage. Each subsequent enemy Hit reduces this bonus by 5%.

2686060763.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060763.desc: Ripping your weapon out of enemies reduces Rupture's Cooldown by 1 second.

2686060764.name: Healing
2686060764.desc: Heal for 22% of your Maximum Life on Hit.

2686060809.name: Gore
2686060809.desc: Rupture now causes an explosion when you rip your weapon out, dealing 50% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

2686060810.name: Blood Pool
2686060810.desc: Rupture now creates a blood pool when you rip your weapon out, inflicting 50% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds. You and your Allies gain 15% increased Attack Speed while standing in the blood pool.

2686060811.name: All For One
2686060811.desc: Casting Rupture Summons 2 Ancients that skewer your target for 20% damage and then performing a rip attack that deals 140% as direct damage instead of Bleeding.

217175.name: Iron Maelstrom
desc: Activate three times to attach chains to each of your weapons and perform an attack:
First, your Two-Handed Bludgeoning weapon slams into the ground, dealing {val1}% damage and Stunning enemies for 2 seconds.
Next, your Two-Handed Slashing weapon swipes in front of you, dealing {val2}% damage and inflicting {val3}% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.
Finally, your Dual Wield weapons swing around you, dealing {val4}% damage per hit.

2686060761.name: Weaken
2686060761.desc: Enemies damaged by Iron Maelstrom Weakened for 4 seconds.

2686060762.name: Additional Effect
2686060762.desc: Each attack gains an additional effect: Two Handed Bludgeoning deals 25%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage Two Handed Slashing deals 20%[x] increased damage to Vulnerable enemies. Dual Wield gains 20% Cast Speed.

2686060763.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060763.desc: Weapon swaps reduce the Cooldown of Iron Maelstrom is by 2 second.

2686060764.name: Global Cooldown Reduction
2686060764.desc: Activating Iron Maelstrom reduces all other active Cooldowns by 2 seconds.

2686060809.name: Armageddon
2686060809.desc: Each attack gains an additional effect: Two Handed Bludgeoning creates a Earthquake that deals 135% Physical damage over 4 seconds, Two-Handed Slashing shoots Iron Shrapnel dealing 3.6% damage inflicting 216% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds Dual Wield forms Dust Devils that each deal 12.9% damage.

2686060810.name: Hidden Technique
2686060810.desc: Iron Maelstrom now has 3 Charges and it always uses the same attack that matches your last used weapon at 75%[x] increased damage.

2686060811.name: Mastered Weapon
2686060811.desc: Depending on your last used weapon, Iron Maelstrom is now also a single Weapon Mastery Skill, and its Cooldown is reduced to 11 seconds.

238345.name: Boulder
desc: Unearth a large rolling boulder that repeatedly Knocks Back enemies, dealing {val1}% damage with each hit.

2686060761.name: Critical Strike Chance
2686060761.desc: Boulder gains 5% Critical Strike Chance. Additionally, Boulder gains an extra 1% increased Critical Strike Chance per stack of Resolve active.

2686060762.name: Additional Boulder
2686060762.desc: Boulder has a 20% chance to launch an additional Boulder for free.

2686060763.name: Slow
2686060763.desc: Enemies hit by Boulder are Slowed by 70% for 3 seconds.

2686060764.name: Fortify
2686060764.desc: Boulder grants 20% of your Maximum Life as Fortify (20) when it successfully hits a target.

2686060809.name: Crushing Impact
2686060809.desc: Boulder deals 300%[x] increased damage to the first enemy hit. This bonus is reduced by 50%[x] for each subsequent enemy hit afterward.

2686060810.name: Dolmen's Will
2686060810.desc: Boulder becomes a Core Skill that costs 60 Spirit, has no Cooldown, and may be cast while moving.  Boulder now orbits you. You may have max 5 Boulders orbiting at once.

2686060811.name: Landslip
2686060811.desc: Boulder can now be cast at the target location. Boulder deals 200% bonus damage to the enemy it lands on.

258243.name: Trample
desc: Shapeshift and charge forward, dealing {val1}% damage and Knocking Back enemies.

1372517862.name: Werewolf
1372517862.desc: Trample becomes a Werewolf Skill allowing you to quickly leap through the air.

2686060761.name: Unstoppable
2686060761.desc: Trample makes you Unstoppable for the duration.

2686060762.name: Spirit
2686060762.desc: Trample grants an additional 20 Spirit.

2686060763.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060763.desc: Reduce Trample's cooldown by 6 seconds.

2686060764.name: Stun
2686060764.desc: Trample Stuns enemies for 3 seconds instead of Knocking Back.

2686060809.name: Brunt Force
2686060809.desc: Trample deals 500% bonus damage to the first target. Each subsequent target hit reduces this bonus by 50%.

2686060810.name: Trampled Earth
2686060810.desc: Trample sunders the earth forming rock pillars along the path and around your target location that deal 120%  damage.  Trample is now an Earth Skill.

2686060811.name: Exsanguination
2686060811.desc: Trampling may Execute enemies in an explosion of blood dealing 150% damage to other nearby enemies and healing you for 10% of your Maximum Life.

258990.name: Hurricane
desc: Form a hurricane around you that deals {val1}% damage to surrounding enemies over 6 seconds.

2686060761.name: Movement Speed
2686060761.desc: Movement Speed is increased by 10%[x] while Hurricane is active.

2686060762.name: Critical Strike Chance
2686060762.desc: Hurricane's Critical Strike Chance is increased by 5% and an additional 2% Critical Strike Chance for each stack of  Ferocity active.

2686060763.name: Weaken
2686060763.desc: Enemies affected by Hurricane are Weakened.

2686060764.name: Slow
2686060764.desc: Hurricane Slows enemies by 50% for 2 seconds.

2686060809.name: Rapid Intensification
2686060809.desc: Each second while active, Hurricane gains 30%[x] bonus damage.

2686060810.name: Twin Storms
2686060810.desc: Hurricane has 2 charges and can now be placed at the targeted location. Enemies hit are Vulnerable and have a 10% chance to spawn 2 Dancing Bolts that deal 22.5% Lightning damage each.  Recharge time: 20 seconds

2686060811.name: Derecho
2686060811.desc: Hurricane has no cooldown and deals 100%[x] bonus damage. Hurricane costs 15 Spirit per second while active. Cast Hurricane again to toggle the effect off.  Hurricane becomes a Core Skill.

265663.name: Wolves
desc: Passive: Summon 2 wolf companions that bite enemies for {val1}% damage.
Active: Command your wolves to use their Feral Dash ability, instantly lunging at the target dealing {val2}% damage and becoming Unstoppable.

2686060761.name: Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Wolves' instantly break out of any Crowd Control effects, becoming enraged and gaining 100%[x] bonus damage for 15 seconds afterward.

2686060762.name: Stun
2686060762.desc: Enemies hit by Feral Dash are Stunned for 1.5 seconds.

2686060763.name: Additional Wolf
2686060763.desc: Gain 1 additional Wolf Companion.

2686060764.name: Attack Speed
2686060764.desc: When your Wolves Critically Strike, you gain 20% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

2686060809.name: Thrill of the Hunt
2686060809.desc: All Wolves' upgrades are increased by 100%.

2686060810.name: Werewolf Pack
2686060810.desc: Wolves is also a Werewolf Skill.  Your Wolf Companions are now Werewolf Companions and deal 50%[x] bonus damage. Werewolf Companions will use Feral Dash on their own against Distant enemies but does not make them Unstoppable.

2686060811.name: Berserking
2686060811.desc: Commanding your Wolves grants you Berserking for 4 seconds.

266570.name: Cataclysm
desc: A massive storm follows you for 8 seconds. Twisters Knock Back enemies dealing {val1}% damage, and lightning strikes wildly dealing {val2}% damage.

2686060761.name: Slow
2686060761.desc: Casting Cataclysm Slows surrounding enemies by 70% for 8 seconds.

2686060762.name: Duration
2686060762.desc: Cataclysm's duration is increased by 4 seconds.

2686060763.name: Ferocity
2686060763.desc: Casting Cataclysm grants 4 stacks of Ferocity.

2686060764.name: Vulnerable
2686060764.desc: Enemies hit by Cataclysm are Vulnerable.

2686060809.name: Severe Storm
2686060809.desc: Cataclysm spawns double the Twister and Lightning Bolts. In addition, Lighting Bolt strikes have a 20% chance to spawn 2-4 Dancing Bolts that deal 40.25% damage.

2686060810.name: Terrible Twisters
2686060810.desc: All Twisters now orbit you and deal 200%[x] bonus damage.

2686060811.name: Tectonic Spikes
2686060811.desc: Cataclysm is also an Earth Skill.  Cataclysm additionally summons Tectonic Spikes around you for the duration dealing 165% Physical damage.

267021.name: Grizzly Rage
desc: Shapeshift into a Dire Werebear for {val1} seconds becoming Berserk and gaining 20% bonus Armor. Your damage is increased by 5%[x] (max. 150%[x]) each time you take or deal damage with a skill while Grizzly Rage is active.

1603373747.name: Werebear
1603373747.desc: Grizzly Rage's duration is increased by 1 second.

2686060761.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060761.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Grizzly Rage by 20 seconds.

2686060762.name: Armor Bonus
2686060762.desc: Increases Grizzly Rage's Armor bonus by an additional 15%.

2686060763.name: Unstoppable
2686060763.desc: Grizzly Rage makes you Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

2686060764.name: Fortify
2686060764.desc: Grizzly Rage grants 100% Fortify when cast.

2686060809.name: Immunity
2686060809.desc: Grizzly Rage grants 2 seconds of Immunity when cast.

2686060810.name: Cornered Beast
2686060810.desc: Increase the maximum amount of bonus damage by another 50%.

2686060811.name: Avatar of Nature
2686060811.desc: Earth and Storm Skills may be cast as a Werebear and deal 35%[x] bonus damage while Grizzly Rage is active.

272138.name: Pulverize
desc: Shapeshift into a Werebear and slam the ground, dealing {val1}% damage to surrounding enemies.

2686060761.name: Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Increase Pulverize's damage by 10%[x] and consumes up to 2 Overpower stacks to further increase the damage bonus by 10%[x] and size of Pulverize by 25% per Overpower stack consumed.

2686060762.name: Cost Reduction
2686060762.desc: Reduces the Spirit cost of Pulverize by 7.

2686060763.name: Weaken
2686060763.desc: Enemies hit with Pulverize are Weakened for 5 seconds.

2686060764.name: Initial Damage Bonus
2686060764.desc: Pulverize deals 20%[x] bonus damage to the first 5 enemies hit.  This bonus is increased to 40%[x] while Berserking.

2686060809.name: Greater Pulverize
2686060809.desc: Pulverize is 30% larger and deals 400% bonus damage split evenly between all targets hit.

2686060810.name: Shockwave
2686060810.desc: Pulverize is also an Earth Skill.  Pulverize summons powerful Tectonic Spikes from the ground that deals 210% damage.

2686060811.name: Mega Bear Punch
2686060811.desc: Pulverize performs a powerful force punch dealing 455% damage to all enemies in front of you. Spirit cost increased to 50.

280119.name: Cyclone Armor
desc: Passive: Powerful winds surround you, granting a {val1}% bonus to All Resistances.
Active: The winds rapidly expand, Knocking Back enemies and dealing {val2}% damage.

1603373747.name: Versatile
1603373747.desc: Cyclone Armor's damage and Non-Physical Damage Reduction are increased by 5%[x].

2686060761.name: Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Active: Cyclone Armor's damage is increased by 200%.

2686060762.name: Increased Radius
2686060762.desc: Active: Cyclone Armor's radius is increased by 50%.

2686060763.name: Vulnerable
2686060763.desc: Passive: Enemies who strike you become Vulnerable for 5 seconds.

2686060764.name: Resistance
2686060764.desc: Passive: Gain an additional 20% bonus to All Resistances.

2686060809.name: Greater Cyclone Armor
2686060809.desc: All bonuses and damage from Cyclone Armor are increased by 100%.

2686060810.name: Slipstream
2686060810.desc: Cyclone Armor Knocks Down enemies hit for 3 seconds.

2686060811.name: Reversal
2686060811.desc: The active winds are reversed pulling enemies towards you instead. In addition, the area of effect is increased by 30%[x].

281516.name: Ravens
desc: Passive: Summon 1 Raven to fly above you, attacking enemies for {val1}% damage every 5 seconds.
Active: The target area is swarmed with ravens, dealing {val2}% damage over 6 seconds.

2686060761.name: Vulnerable
2686060761.desc: Passive: Raven attacks make enemies Vulnerable.

2686060762.name: Active Damage Bonus
2686060762.desc: Active: Raven's active damage is increased by 300%[x].

2686060763.name: Resolve
2686060763.desc: Passive: Raven's attacks grant 1 stack of Resolve once every 2 seconds.

2686060764.name: Additional Raven
2686060764.desc: Passive: Gain 2 additional Ravens.

2686060809.name: Raven Flock
2686060809.desc: Passive: Increases Raven's passive attack speed by 100% and gain 2 additional Raven Companions.

2686060810.name: Stormcrow
2686060810.desc: Ravens is also a Storm Skill that deal Lightning damage.  Active: Enemies are stunned for 3 seconds.

2686060811.name: Migration
2686060811.desc: Active: The active area is 50% larger. If the target dies, the Raven Flock moves itself towards new target.

287256.name: Frost Bolt
desc: Throw a bolt of frost at an enemy, dealing {val1}% damage and Chilling for 35%.

2686060761.name: Barrier
2686060761.desc: Frost Bolt grants a Barrier for 2% of your Maximum Life (2) up to 6% for 6 seconds when it hits the first enemy.

2686060762.name: Resource Generation
2686060762.desc: Frost Bolt generates 2 Mana when it hits the first enemy, or 4 Mana if the target is already Frozen.

2686060763.name: Vulnerable
2686060763.desc: Frost Bolt makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

2686060764.name: Pierce
2686060764.desc: Frost Bolt pierces 1 time.

2686060809.name: Relentless Bolt
2686060809.desc: Frost Bolt launches an additional projectile after the first. Each projectile deals 72% damage.

2686060810.name: Shatter
2686060810.desc: Frost Bolt shatters when it hits a Frozen enemy, exploding for 270% damage and Chilling for 40%.

2686060811.name: Static Shock
2686060811.desc: Frost Bolt becomes a Shock Skill that deals Lightning damage.  Frost Bolt arcs 1 to 3 times to additional enemies, dealing 36% damage with each arc and Weakening them for 4 seconds.

288106.name: Teleport
desc: Transform into lightning and surge to the target location, dealing {val1}% damage around you upon arrival.

2686060761.name: Weaken
2686060761.desc: Teleport Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

2686060762.name: Movement Speed
2686060762.desc: Teleport increases your Movement Speed by 10% for 4 seconds.

2686060763.name: Ferocity
2686060763.desc: Teleport grants 2 stack of Ferocity if it hits an enemy.

2686060764.name: Crackling Energy
2686060764.desc: Teleport forms 2 Crackling Energy at the ending location.

2686060809.name: Electrobolt
2686060809.desc: Teleport pulls in all Close Crackling Energy and reduces the Cooldown of the next Teleport by 0.30 seconds per Crackling Energy gained this way.

2686060810.name: Wormhole
2686060810.desc: Teleport Stuns enemies hit for 0.50 seconds, and there is a 2 second window where you can cast Teleport again.

2686060811.name: Blaze
2686060811.desc: Teleport becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals 59.5% Fire damage.  Teleport now only dashes you forward a short distance and will consume 1 stack of Overpower to refund its Cooldown.

291215.name: Frost Nova
desc: Unleash a torrent of frost, Freezing enemies around you for {val1} seconds.

2686060761.name: Size Bonus
2686060761.desc: Frost Nova's Size is increased by 50%.

2686060762.name: Resource Generation
2686060762.desc: Each enemy Frozen by Frost Nova generates 5 Mana.

2686060763.name: Vulnerable
2686060763.desc: Frost Nova makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

2686060764.name: Charge
2686060764.desc: Frost Nova gains 1 additional Charge, but its Cooldown is increased by 6 seconds.

2686060809.name: Shatter
2686060809.desc: Enemies that die while Frozen by Frost Nova have a 100% chance to unleash an additional Frost Nova.

2686060810.name: Cold Front
2686060810.desc: Frost Nova is now cast at a target location, and each enemy Frozen by it reduces the cooldowns of your Frost Skills by 0.5 seconds.

2686060811.name: Freezing Mist
2686060811.desc: Instead of Freezing, Frost Nova forms an aura of frigid mist around you that deals 175% Frostbite damage over 4 seconds.

291347.name: Frozen Orb
desc: Unleash an whirling orb that deals {val1}% Frostbite damage over 3 seconds and Chills for 25%. After 1 second Frozen Orb will explode, dealing {val2}% damage.

2686060761.name: Damage Over Time Bonus
2686060761.desc: Frozen Orb deals 100%[x] increased Frostbite damage.

2686060762.name: Barrier
2686060762.desc: Frozen Orb grants a Barrier for 5% of your Maximum Life (5) for 3 seconds for each enemy hit by its explosion, up to 50%.

2686060763.name: Explosion Damage Bonus
2686060763.desc: Frozen Orb deals 30%[x] increased explosion damage.

2686060764.name: Duration Bonus
2686060764.desc: Frozen Orb lasts 1 additional second before exploding.

2686060809.name: Seeking Orb
2686060809.desc: When Frozen Orb first explodes it remains stationary for 0.5 seconds then seeks another target to explode again, dealing 89.6% damage.

2686060810.name: Shattered Path
2686060810.desc: Ice Spikes spawn around Frozen Orb, dealing 56% damage.  Frozen Orb makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

2686060811.name: Great Orbs of Fire
2686060811.desc: Frozen Orb becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals 62.4% Burning damage over 2 seconds and explodes for 145.6% Fire damage  Frozen Orb will consume 1 stack of Overpower to explode 3 times along its path.

291403.name: Blizzard
desc: Call forth a frigid blizzard that deals {val1}% Frostbite damage and continually Chills enemies for 100% over 4 seconds.

2686060761.name: Barrier
2686060761.desc: Blizzard grants you a Barrier that absorbs 0.5% of your Maximum Life for 4 seconds every second for each affected enemy.

2686060762.name: Damage Bonus
2686060762.desc: Blizzard deals 30%[x] increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.

2686060763.name: Seek and Duration Bonus
2686060763.desc: Blizzard now seeks enemies and its duration is increased by 50%.

2686060764.name: Resource Generation
2686060764.desc: Blizzard deals 3%[x] increased damage and grants 2 Mana Regeneration for each active Blizzard, up to 10 Mana.

2686060809.name: Exposure
2686060809.desc: Blizzard's duration is increased to 6 seconds and it makes enemies Vulnerable.

2686060810.name: Hailstorm
2686060810.desc: Blizzard forms Ice Spikes that explode twice if they hit a Vulnerable enemy, dealing 49% damage.

2686060811.name: Static Field
2686060811.desc: Blizzard becomes a Shock Skill, deals 525% Sparking damage over 1.0 seconds, and costs 15 Mana.  Blizzard periodically Stuns enemies for 0.25 seconds.

291492.name: Ice Blades
desc: Conjure blades of ice for 6.0 seconds that rapidly slash enemies, dealing {val1}% damage and making them Vulnerable.
You may have up to 3 Ice Blades active at a time.

2686060761.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060761.desc: Ice Blades' Cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds each time it attacks an enemy.

2686060762.name: Area Bonus
2686060762.desc: Ice Blades now cleave.

2686060763.name: Cast Speed
2686060763.desc: Ice Blades gains 50% Cast Speed when attacking Frozen enemies.

2686060764.name: Duration Bonus
2686060764.desc: Ice Blades' duration is increased by 5 seconds.

2686060809.name: Ice Crack
2686060809.desc: Every 3rd slash from Ice Blades is an Ice Crack, dealing 230% damage in a large cone.

2686060810.name: Frozen Tomb
2686060810.desc: Ice Blades is now cast at the target location and surrounds it with 3 Ice Blades.  Ice Blades Chill enemies for 10%, but their Movement Speed is reduced by 50%.

2686060811.name: Blazing Blades
2686060811.desc: Ice Blades becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals 115% Fire damage.  Ice Blades no longer has a Cooldown, but costs 20 Mana. Ice Blades gain 30% Cast Speed.

291827.name: Deep Freeze
desc: Encase yourself in ice and become Immune for 4 seconds, Chilling surrounding enemies for 13% and continuously dealing {val1}% damage to them. When Deep Freeze ends, you explode for an additional {val2}% damage.
Casting Deep Freeze again ends the effect early.

2686060761.name: Duration
2686060761.desc: Increases the duration to 5 seconds.

2686060762.name: Vulnerable and Weakened
2686060762.desc: Damage makes enemies Vulnerable and Weakened for 8 seconds.

2686060763.name: Reduce Cooldown
2686060763.desc: Reduces your Cooldowns by 1 second and generate 8 Mana every second while active.

2686060764.name: Cooldown with Barrier
2686060764.desc: Cooldown speed is increased by 50% while you have a Barrier.

2686060809.name: Frigid Ward
2686060809.desc: Deep Freeze forms a Barrier that absorbs 7.5(30% of Maximum Life) damage every second while active, and also forms exploding Ice Spikes in the area, dealing 39.37% Cold damage.  This Barrier grants 10 Mana Regeneration.

2686060810.name: Bonechill
2686060810.desc: Deep Freeze's continuous and final explosion damage become Frostbite damage that deals 420% and 1,440% damage over 4 seconds respectively.  This Frostbite damage Chills for 100% over 4 seconds and will remove Unstoppable from enemies.

2686060811.name: Glacier
2686060811.desc: Instead of encasing yourself and becoming Immune, Deep Freeze now forms at the target location dealing 63% damage continuously and 216% explosion damage.  You remain free to act during the duration and Deep Freeze now has 3 Charges.

292074.name: Lightning Spear
desc: Summon a spear of lightning that seeks out enemies for 6.0 seconds, dealing {val1}% damage per hit.
You may have up to 12 Lightning Spears active at a time.

2686060761.name: Projectile Speed
2686060761.desc: Lightning Spears move 50% faster.

2686060762.name: Duration Bonus
2686060762.desc: When a Lightning Spear Critically Strikes, its duration is increased by 0.1 seconds.

2686060763.name: Damage Bonus
2686060763.desc: Lightning Spear deals 100%[x] increased damage. This bonus is reduced by 10%[x] each time Lightning Spear deals damage to an enemy.

2686060764.name: Critical Strike
2686060764.desc: Lightning Spear gains 10% increased Critical Strike Chance.

2686060809.name: Chain Reaction
2686060809.desc: Lightning Spear arcs to 2 additional surrounding targets dealing 48% damage. Critical Strikes greatly increase the range of the arcs.

2686060810.name: Reverse Polarity
2686060810.desc: Lightning Spear fires 2 spears that deal 96% damage Stun enemies for 1.0 second. Enemies can only be Stunned this way once every 5 seconds.

2686060811.name: Flame Spear
2686060811.desc: Lightning Spear becomes a Pyromancy Skill, deals 198% Fire damage, but its Cooldown is increased by 5 seconds  Burning enemies hit by Lightning Spear explode for 120%.

292737.name: Incinerate
desc: Channel a beam of fire, dealing {val1}% damage and an additional {val2}% Burning damage over 4 seconds.
Incinerate's damage increases by 50%[x] every second you channel it, up to 100%[x].

2686060761.name: Healthy Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Incinerate deals 25%[x] increased damage while you are Healthy.

2686060762.name: Healing
2686060762.desc: Incinerate heals you for 2% of your Maximum Life (2) per enemy hit.

2686060763.name: Overpower
2686060763.desc: Incinerate gains a 20% chance to deal double damage while you have a stack of Overpower.

2686060764.name: Execute
2686060764.desc: Incinerate Executes enemies.

2686060809.name: Focused Flame
2686060809.desc: Incinerate maximum damage bonus while channeling is increased to 200%[x].  Incinerate's Size is increased by 200% when you reach the maximum damage bonus.

2686060810.name: Flamethrower
2686060810.desc: Incinerate gains 2 additional beams and deals its Burning damage 50% faster, but its range is reduced.

2686060811.name: Disintegration
2686060811.desc: Incinerate becomes a Shock Skill that deals Lightning damage.  Incinerate's beam no longer penetrates enemies and it now deals 140% damage to the first enemy hit and an additional 140% damage distributed among up to 5 enemies around them.

292757.name: Chain Lightning
desc: Unleash a bolt of lightning that chains up to 5 times, dealing {val1}% damage.
If Chain Lightning fails to chain, 50%[x] of the remaining chains damage is dealt as additional damage to the final target.

2686060761.name: Additional Chains
2686060761.desc: Chain Lightning gains 1 additional chains.

2686060762.name: Damage Bonus
2686060762.desc: Chain Lightning deals 100%[x] increased damage to the first enemy hit.

2686060763.name: Ramping Damage
2686060763.desc: Every Second, Chain Lightning gains 5%[x] damage, up to 25%[x]. This bonus is reset when you damage an enemy with a Skill Cast other than Chain Lightning.

2686060764.name: Critical Strike Chance
2686060764.desc: Chain Lightning forms a Crackling Energy whenever it Critically Strikes.  Chain Lightning gains 5% Critical Strike Chance.

2686060809.name: Chain Whipping
2686060809.desc: Chain Lightning gains 20% Cast Speed and its number of chains is doubled.

2686060810.name: Power Flux
2686060810.desc: Chain Lightning alternates between chaining to an enemy and to you. When it chains to you, it gains 45%[x] increased damage, up to 180%[x], and does not use a chain.

2686060811.name: Chain of Cold
2686060811.desc: Chain Lightning becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage.  Chain Lightning Chills by 25% and deals up to 100%[x] increased damage based on how Chilled the enemy is, dealing the maximum damage if they are Frozen.

293195.name: Ice Shards
desc: Launch 5 icy shards, dealing {val1}% damage each and piercing 1 time.
Ice Shards deals 50%[x] increased damage to Frozen enemies.

2686060761.name: Pierce Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Ice Shards deals 20%[x] increased damage after piercing once.

2686060762.name: Cost Reduction
2686060762.desc: Ice Shards' Mana cost is reduced by 3.

2686060763.name: Barrier
2686060763.desc: Ice Shards launches 1 additional shard while you have a Barrier.

2686060764.name: Hit Damage Bonus
2686060764.desc: Ice Shards deals 10%[x] increased damage to an enemy each time it hits them in the same cast.

2686060809.name: Piercing Cold
2686060809.desc: Ice Shards deals 50%[x] increased damage and will pierce 1 additional time.  Ice Shards will additionally pierce up to 3 Vulnerable enemies.

2686060810.name: Glacial Spike
2686060810.desc: Ice Shards combines all shards into a massive spike, dealing 10%[x] increased damage per shard. The spike explodes on impact and Chills for 50%.

2686060811.name: Thunderbolt
2686060811.desc: Ice Shards becomes a Shock Skill that deals Lightning damage.  Ice Shards launches a large thunderbolt that explodes on impact into 5 smaller seeking thunderbolt shards, dealing 33% damage each.

294198.name: Inferno
desc: Summon a fiery serpent that deals {val1}% damage and Burns enemies for {val2}% damage over 4 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

2686060761.name: Pull
2686060761.desc: Inferno continuously pulls enemies towards the center.

2686060762.name: Overpower
2686060762.desc: Inferno overfills your Overpower by 2 stacks.

2686060763.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060763.desc: Inferno's Cooldown is reduced to 12 seconds, but it now also costs 30 Mana.

2686060764.name: Direct Damage Bonus
2686060764.desc: Inferno's Burning damage is now converted to direct Fire damage, allowing it to Critically Strike.  Inferno deals 20% increased Critical Strike Damage.

2686060809.name: Living Bomb
2686060809.desc: Inferno's Burning duration is increased to 8 seconds. Enemies killed by Inferno explode, dealing 106.25% damage.

2686060810.name: Meteor Shower
2686060810.desc: Inferno triggers Meteorites that deal 148.75% to enemies and Immobilize them for 1.0 second.

2686060811.name: Lifecoil
2686060811.desc: Inferno now forms around you and follows you, healing you for 50% of your Maximum Life per second.

296998.name: Meteor
desc: Call down a meteor that crashes into enemies, dealing {val1}% damage and an additional {val2}% Burning damage over 3 seconds.

2686060761.name: Resource Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Meteor now consumes all your remaining Mana on Cast, dealing 2%[x] increased damage for each point of extra Mana spent.

2686060762.name: Immobilize
2686060762.desc: Meteor Immobilizes enemies for 3 seconds on impact.

2686060763.name: Damage and Size Bonus
2686060763.desc: Meteor deals 50%[x] increased damage and has 50%[x] increased Size, but now also has a 15 second Cooldown.

2686060764.name: Overpower
2686060764.desc: Meteor's Impact damage now grants 1 stack of Overpower per enemy hit.

2686060809.name: Shooting Star
2686060809.desc: Removes the falling delay before Meteor crashes down.  Meteor now deals 408% impact damage and 102% Burning damage over 3 seconds.

2686060810.name: Air Burst
2686060810.desc: Meteor rains down 6 Meteorites before the final impact that each deal 87.5% damage each, but Meteor no longer deals Burning damage.

2686060811.name: Comet
2686060811.desc: Meteor becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage.  Meteor calls down an icy Comet that deals 360% damage and creates an icy mist that inflicts 66% Frostbite and 50% Chill over 3 seconds.

297039.name: Ice Armor
desc: A Barrier of ice forms around you for 4 seconds, absorbing {val1}% of your Maximum Life ({val2}) in damage.

2686060761.name: Duration Bonus and Barrier
2686060761.desc: Ice Armor's duration is increased to 5 seconds and its Barrier amount is increased by 20%[x].

2686060762.name: Frozen and Chill
2686060762.desc: Close enemies that attack you while Ice Armor is active will be Frozen or Chilled for 10%.

2686060763.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060763.desc: Ice Armor's Cooldown is reduced to 16 seconds.

2686060764.name: Resource Regeneration
2686060764.desc: Ice Armor grants 5 Mana Regeneration while active.

2686060809.name: Permafrost
2686060809.desc: Ice Armor grants Unstoppable for 1 second and increases your Armor by 50% while active.

2686060810.name: Razor Ice
2686060810.desc: Ice Armor forms 2 Ice Spikes per second under Close enemies that deal 25% damage.

2686060811.name: Blast Chill
2686060811.desc: Ice Armor also applies to Nearby Allies and increases All Resistances by 10%[x].

297902.name: Arc Lash
desc: Unleash arcing lightning, dealing {val1}% damage to enemies in front of you.

2686060761.name: Ferocity
2686060761.desc: Arc Lash grants 1 stack of Ferocity.

2686060762.name: Damage Bonus
2686060762.desc: Arc Lash deals 50%[x] increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.

2686060763.name: Resource Generation
2686060763.desc: Arc Lash generates 5 Mana when it hits the first enemy.

2686060764.name: Stun
2686060764.desc: Every 8 seconds your next Arc Lash will Stun all enemies hit for 2 seconds.

2686060809.name: Full Lash
2686060809.desc: Arc Lash now casts from both sides in a larger arc, hitting enemies caught in the middle twice.

2686060810.name: Inescapable Reach
2686060810.desc: Arc Lash launches a swift projectile that unleashes arcing lightning at the first enemy hit, dealing up to 150%[x] increased damage based on how far the projectile travels.  Hitting an enemy with Arc Lash's projectile increases your Movement Speed by 4% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 20%.

2686060811.name: Icy Thrash
2686060811.desc: Arc Lash becomes a Frost Skill, deals Cold damage, and Chills for 25%.  Arc Lash has a larger range and deals up to 100%[x] increased damage based on how Chilled the enemy is, dealing the maximum damage if they are Frozen.

304065.name: Tornado
desc: Conjure a swirling tornado for 4 seconds that deals {val1}% damage to enemies.

2686060761.name: Additional Tornado
2686060761.desc: Each time you cast Tornado, there is a 20% chance to spawn an additional Tornado.

2686060762.name: Increased Duration
2686060762.desc: Extend the duration of Tornado by 1 second. Additionally, hitting a Vulnerable enemy extends the duration further by 0.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 2 seconds.

2686060763.name: Cast Speed
2686060763.desc: Tornado's Cast Speed is increased by 20%[x].

2686060764.name: Slow
2686060764.desc: Tornado Slows enemies hit by 70% for 2 seconds.

2686060809.name: Swelling Storm
2686060809.desc: Tornadoes gain a stacking 35%[x] damage bonus each second while active. After 3 seconds, Tornadoes gain a 50% Critical Strike Chance.

2686060810.name: Explosive Tornado
2686060810.desc: After colliding with the target, Tornado explodes into 4 Mini-Tornadoes that seek enemies dealing 14% damage. Mini-Tornadoes have half the normal duration.

2686060811.name: Greater Tornado
2686060811.desc: Two Tornadoes can merge into a Greater Tornado. Greater Tornadoes are 50% larger and deal 100% bonus damage.

309070.name: Maul
desc: Shapeshift into a Werebear and maul enemies in front of you, dealing {val1}% damage.

2686060761.name: Berserking
2686060761.desc: Maul has a 25% chance when first dealing damage to grant Berserking for 4 seconds.

2686060762.name: Resolve
2686060762.desc: Maul's grants 1 stack of Resolve per cast when dealing damage.

2686060763.name: Overpower
2686060763.desc: Maul's grants 1 stack of Overpower per cast when dealing damage.

2686060764.name: Spirit
2686060764.desc: Maul generates an additional 10 Spirit.

2686060809.name: Wide Sweeps
2686060809.desc: Increases the range and radius of Maul by 50%. Maul's damage is increased to 120%.

2686060810.name: Reckless Rage
2686060810.desc: Maul deals 250%[x] increased damage but generates 10 less Spirit.

2686060811.name: Stone Fists
2686060811.desc: Maul is also an Earth Skill.  Maul turns your fists to stone allowing you to punch enemies with the might of the Earth dealing 160% damage.

309320.name: Storm Strike
desc: Electricity gathers around your weapon, dealing {val1}% damage to your target and chaining up to 2 times to targets nearby.

1371751944.name: Werebear
1371751944.desc: Storm Strike becomes a Werebear Skill.

1372517862.name: Werewolf
1372517862.desc: Storm Strike becomes a Werewolf Skill.

1603373747.name: Human
1603373747.desc: Storm Strike's damage is increased by 10%[x].

2686060761.name: Armor
2686060761.desc: You gain 15% Armor for 4 seconds when dealing damage.

2686060762.name: Additional Chain
2686060762.desc: Storm Strike may chain 1 additional time.

2686060763.name: Ferocity
2686060763.desc: Storm Strike grants 1 stack of Ferocity when first dealing damage.

2686060764.name: Spirit
2686060764.desc: Storm Strike grants 25 Spirit when a single enemy is hit at least 3 times per cast.

2686060809.name: Chain Reaction
2686060809.desc: Storm Strike chains 3 additional times. Storm Strike's chain damage increases by 20% each time it chains.

2686060810.name: Storm Hammer
2686060810.desc: Storm Strike deals 96% Lightning damage and can be cast from range becoming a swift projectile.  Additionally, Storm Strike Immobilizes enemies for 3 seconds. May occur once every 8 seconds per enemy.

2686060811.name: Focused Strike
2686060811.desc: Storm Strike chaining will always prioritize the same target until that target dies. Chaining to the same target deals 150%[x] increased damage.

309802.name: Call of the Ancients
desc: Summon 3 Ancients to aid you in battle for 10 seconds.
Korlic leaps at enemies, dealing {val1}% damage and swings his weapons in a frenzy, dealing {val2}% damage per hit.
Talic spins in a whirlwind rapidly attacking enemies for {val3}% damage.
Madawc upheaves the ground, dealing {val4}% damage.

2686060761.name: Ancient Attack Speed
2686060761.desc: Your Ancients attack 25% faster.

2686060762.name: Attack Speed and Damage Bonus
2686060762.desc: When you Cast Call of the Ancients, gain 5% Attack Speed and 5%[x] increased damage for each Ancient summoned for 6 seconds.

2686060763.name: Damage Bonus
2686060763.desc: You and each of your Ancients summoned from this Skill increase each other's damage by 7%[x].

2686060764.name: Damage Reduction
2686060764.desc: When you Cast Call of the Ancients, gain 5% Damage Reduction for each Ancient summoned while they are active.

2686060809.name: Empowered
2686060809.desc: Your Ancients are empowered: Korlic creates an Earthquake that deals 99% Physical damage over 4 seconds when he leaps. Talic leaves behind Dust Devils that deal 72% damage while he whirlwinds. Madawc ignites the earth, Burning enemies for an additional 22.5% damage over 4 seconds when he upheaves the ground.

2686060810.name: The Chosen
2686060810.desc: Depending on your last used weapon, you summon 1 very strong Ancient for twice as long.  Your Ancient gains an additional power: Korlic: You gain 10 Fury each time Korlic damages an enemy with his Frenzy. Talic: Enemies are Slowed by 50% for 1 second when damaged by his Whirlwind. Madawc: 30% chance to Stun enemies for 3 seconds when using his Upheaval.

2686060811.name: Highlander
2686060811.desc: Summon a single, permanent Ancient. Using this skill again replaces it with the next Ancient.

313893.name: Landslide
desc: Crush enemies with 3 pillars of earth, each dealing {val1}% damage.

2686060761.name: Initial Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Landslide deals 100% bonus damage when hitting the first enemy.

2686060762.name: Additional Pillar
2686060762.desc: Gain 1 additional pillar.

2686060763.name: Critical Strike Chance
2686060763.desc: Landslide's Critical Strike Chance is increased by 5% and up to an additional 15% based on how much of your Maximum Life is Fortified.

2686060764.name: Resolve
2686060764.desc: Landslide grants 1 stack of Resolve when hitting the first enemy.

2686060809.name: Continental Shift
2686060809.desc: Gain 2 additional pillars. In addition, Landslide's size is increased by 50% and damage is increased to 74.25%.

2686060810.name: Vengeance of Earth
2686060810.desc: Landslide's pillars automatically crush individual targets in the area.  Landslide gains a 120% damage bonus for the first pillar, reducing by 30% for each subsequent pillar.

2686060811.name: Land Mine
2686060811.desc: When cast, Landslide is dormant at the target location for 1 second. Afterwards, Landslide will automatically trigger when an enemy steps on it, dealing 500% bonus damage split between all enemies damaged.  Max 5 Landslides can be active at a time and last 20 seconds. Landslide is also a Trap Skill.

314601.name: Poison Creeper
desc: Passive: Summon 1 poison creeper to periodically emerge from the ground every 7 seconds, applying {val1}% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds to an enemy in the area.
Active: Vines strangle all enemies surrounding you, Immobilizing them for 2 seconds and Poisoning them for {val2}% damage over 2 seconds.

1603373747.name: Versatile
1603373747.desc: Poison Creeper's damage is increased by 5%[x].

2686060761.name: Additional Poison Creeper
2686060761.desc: Passive: Gain 1 additional Poison Creeper Companions.

2686060762.name: Active Poisoning Duration
2686060762.desc: Active: Poison Creeper's active Poisoning duration is increased by 3 seconds.

2686060763.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060763.desc: Active: Reduces Poison Creeper's Cooldown by 8 seconds.

2686060764.name: Fortify
2686060764.desc: Passive: Poison Creeper grants 10% Fortify every 3 seconds.

2686060809.name: Germinate
2686060809.desc: Active: Enemies that die while afflicted with the active Poisoning damage have a 20% chance to trigger another active effect for free.

2686060810.name: Carnivorous
2686060810.desc: Active:  Poison Creeper immediately deals 144% direct damage.

2686060811.name: Toxic Vegetation
2686060811.desc: Active: Poison Creeper's active effect becomes an aura around you for 4 seconds, dealing 324% total Poisoning damage and Slowing enemies by 80%. Poison Creeper no longer Immobilizes.

323105.name: Death Blow
desc: Attempt a killing strike, dealing {val1}% damage to enemies in front of you.
If this kills an enemy, its Cooldown is reset.

2686060761.name: Execute
2686060761.desc: Enemies you hit with Death Blow can be Executed by any of your attacks for the next 2 seconds, resetting Death Blow's cooldown on a successful Execution

2686060762.name: Overpower
2686060762.desc: Death Blow grants 1 stack of Overpower when it kills an enemy.

2686060763.name: Fury Generation
2686060763.desc: Killing an enemy with Death Blow restores 100% of your Fury.

2686060764.name: Charges
2686060764.desc: Death Blow has 2 charges.

2686060809.name: Consecutive
2686060809.desc: Death Blow's cooldown is reduced to 3 seconds.  Hitting enemies with Death Blow increases the damage of subsequent casts by 25%[x] per hit enemy, up to 75%[x]. Kills reset this bonus.

2686060810.name: Sonic Boom
2686060810.desc: Death Blow creates a shockwave that deals 525% damage.

2686060811.name: Blast
2686060811.desc: Death Blow now deals Fire damage and deals an additional 225% Burning damage over 5 seconds.  Enemies that die to Death Blow while Burning or to Death Blow's burn trigger a fiery explosion for 30% damage to surrounding enemies.

333421.name: Earthen Bulwark
desc: Rocks surround you for 6 seconds, granting a Barrier that absorbs {val1}% of your Maximum Life ({val2}) in damage.

1603373747.name: Versatile
1603373747.desc: Earthen Bulwark grants 5% Resource Cost Reduction while active.

2686060761.name: Barrier Duration and Bonus
2686060761.desc: Extends the Barrier duration to 12 seconds and increase the base absorption amount to 4% of your Maximum Life.

2686060762.name: Fortify and Healing
2686060762.desc: You are Fortified for 7% per second while Earthen Bulwark is active. In addition, Heal for 15% of your Maximum Life if Earthen Bulwark is fully depleted from damage.

2686060763.name: Overpower
2686060763.desc: Casting Earthen Bulwark grants 2 stacks of Overpower.

2686060764.name: Unstoppable
2686060764.desc: Casting Earthen Bulwark makes you Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

2686060809.name: Reconstruction

2686060810.name: Earthen Shrapnel

2686060811.name: Travertine Bulwark
2686060811.desc: Earthen Bulwark grants 3 stacks of Resolve. In addition, Earthen Bulwark summons Tectonic Spikes that deal 150% total damage to enemies around you.

336238.name: Debilitating Roar
desc: Shapeshift into a Werebear and bellow a mighty roar reducing Nearby enemies' damage dealt by 25% for {val1} seconds.

2686060763.name: Maximum Life

2686060809.name: Booming Roar

351722.name: Petrify

1603373747.name: Human

2686060762.name: Spirit

2686060764.name: Fortify

2686060809.name: Greater Petrify

2686060810.name: Seismic Shift
2686060810.desc: When enemies are Petrified, they take 1,000% damage.

2686060811.name: Enduring Consequences

355606.name: Shadow Step
desc: Quickly move through the shadows to stab your victim from behind for {val1}% damage and Execute them. Gain 15% increased Movement Speed for 4 seconds afterwards.

140266582.name: Vulnerable

140266583.name: Cooldown

2686060809.name: Sight Unseen

2686060810.name: Safe Arrival
2686060810.desc: Shadow Step Dazes its primary target for 3 seconds and leaves 4 Stun Grenades at its feet that each deal 10% damage.

2686060811.name: Artifice

355926.name: Rapid Fire
desc: Rapidly fire 7 arrows, each dealing {val1}% damage and ricocheting 2 times.
Combo Points increase damage and arrows fired:

140266583.name: Energy Gain

140266584.name: Ferocity

140266585.name: Additional Projectiles

2686060809.name: Ruckus
2686060809.desc: Rapid Fire deals 48% damage and ricochets to 1 additional target.

2686060810.name: Explosive Shot

140266583.name: Unstoppable

140266585.desc: Rain of Arrows' Cast Speed is increased by 50% and Lucky Hit Chance is increased by 50%[x].

2686060809.name: Monsoon
2686060809.desc: Rain of Arrows no longer Immobilizes, and instead, its first wave Knocks Down enemies for 3 seconds.  Casting Rain of Arrows consumes 4 stacks of Overpower to send out 2 additional waves, each dealing 180% damage.

2686060810.name: Crashing Waves
2686060810.desc: Rain of Arrows now comes in from the sides in shorter waves and no longer Immobilizes, but instead deals 630% damage, Knocks Back enemies towards the center, and makes them Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

2686060811.name: Flash Flood
2686060811.desc: Rain of Arrows also unleashes 5 Arrow Storms that target Nearby enemies, each dealing 90% damage.

416057.name: Invigorating Strike
desc: Melee attack an enemy, dealing {val1}% damage and also gain 3 Energy once every 1.0 seconds for 4 seconds.

140266582.name: Energy
140266582.desc: Gain 2 additional Energy once every 1.0 seconds after hitting an enemy with Invigorating Strike. If a Close enemy is Crowd Controlled, the additional Energy gain is increased to 4.

140266583.name: Cast Speed
140266583.desc: Increases Invigorating Strike Cast Speed by 5% when hitting an enemy for the first time, up to 20%, for 4 seconds.

140266584.name: Vulnerable
140266584.desc: Hitting an enemy with Invigorating Strike makes them Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

140266585.name: Healing
140266585.desc: Heal for 2% of your Maximum Life once every 1.0 seconds for 4 seconds after hitting an enemy with Invigorating Strike.

2686060809.name: Accumulating Strike
2686060809.desc: Invigorating Strike now deals 113.75% damage and every 3rd cast grants 1 stack of Resolve and 1 stack of Ferocity.

2686060810.name: Quick Strike
2686060810.desc: Invigorating Strike is also a Mobility Skill.  Casting Invigorating Strike now dashes you to the target, dealing 113.75% damage and granting 10%[x] increased Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

2686060811.name: Enervating Strike
2686060811.desc: Invigorating Strike now cleaves, dealing 84.5% Cold damage and Chilling enemies for 20% per attack.

416272.name: Forceful Arrow
desc: Fire a powerful arrow at an enemy, dealing {val1}% damage and Propelling Close enemies, Knocking Back the enemy. Propel can occur once every 2 seconds per enemy.

140266582.name: Vulnerable
140266582.desc: Forceful Arrow causes enemies to become Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

140266583.name: Energy
140266583.desc: Gain 3 Energy when Forceful Arrow damages an enemy and an additional 4 Energy after attempting to Propel an enemy.

140266584.name: Ferocity
140266584.desc: Forceful Arrow grants 1 stacks of Ferocity after attempting to Propel an enemy.

140266585.name: Overpower
140266585.desc: Forceful Arrow grants 1 stack of Overpower after attempting to Propel an enemy.

2686060809.name: Pin
2686060809.desc: Forceful Arrow now Immobilizes Knocked Back enemies for 1 second and deals 87.5% damage. Forceful Arrow's Knock Back range is increased by 50%.

2686060810.name: Ender
2686060810.desc: Forceful Arrow pierces through the first enemy hit, deals 82.5% damage, and has a 30% chance to Execute enemies.

2686060811.name: Cloudburst
2686060811.desc: Forceful Arrow's Propel no longer Knocks Back Close enemies and instead creates an Arrow Storm every 3 arrows, dealing 112.5% damage and Slowing enemies hit by 50% for 2 seconds.

416337.name: Rabies
desc: Perform an infectious bite against enemies in front of you, dealing {val1}% damage and applying an additional {val2}% Poisoning damage over 6.0 seconds.
Infected enemies spread Rabies to other surrounding targets.

2686060761.name: Spread Distance
2686060761.desc: Rabies spread distance is increased by 100%.

2686060762.name: Poisoning Speed
2686060762.desc: Rabies deals its total Poisoning damage 50% faster.

2686060763.name: Healing
2686060763.desc: Enemies that die while affected by Rabies will heal you for 2% Maximum Life.

2686060764.name: Cost Reduction
2686060764.desc: Rabies' Cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.

2686060809.name: Relapse
2686060809.desc: Rabies becomes a Core Skill, costs costs 45 Spirit, and has no Cooldown.  Rabies spread can reinfect enemies who already have the disease up to 3 times per cast.

2686060810.name: Superinfection
2686060810.desc: Rabies becomes a Core Skill, costs 30 Spirit, and has no Cooldown.  Rabies deals 1500%[x] increased damage but only spreads to one target a time.

2686060811.name: Malaise
2686060811.desc: Rabies deals its full damage after 4 seconds as Direct Damage to the target. This Direct Damage gains 150% (300% while Berserking) bonus Critical Strike Damage.

416528.name: Poison Trap
desc: Place a trap that arms after 1.25 seconds. It activates when an enemy moves within range, applying {val1}% Poisoning damage over 9 seconds to enemies in the area.
You can have 4 armed traps out at once.

140266582.name: Knock Down
140266582.desc: Poison Trap Knocks Down enemies for 2 seconds when it activates.

140266583.name: Resolve
140266583.desc: Casting Poison Trap grants 2 stacks of Resolve.

140266584.name: Charges
140266584.desc: Poison Trap gains 1 Charge.

140266585.name: Vulnerable
140266585.desc: Poison Trap makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds when it activates.

2686060809.name: Contamination
2686060809.desc: Poison Trap bursts for an additional 162% damage when it triggers. Enemies hit by this burst take 40%[x] increased damage from Poison Trap.

2686060810.name: Infiltrator
2686060810.desc: Poison Trap's Cooldown is reduced by 3.0 seconds. Poison Trap has no arm time, no longer breaks Stealth, and triggers no Cooldown while you are in Stealth. All Poison Traps activate when you exit Stealth and begin Poison Trap's Cooldown.

2686060811.name: Frostbite Trap
2686060811.desc: Poison Trap no longer deals Poisoning damage and instead deals 945% Frostbite damage and Chills enemies for 20% per second.

421161.name: Death Trap
desc: Place a trap that arms after 1.25 seconds. It activates once an enemy is within range, dealing a total of {val1}% damage in the area.

140266582.name: Cooldown
140266582.desc: Killing an enemy or dealing damage to an Elite for the first time with Death Trap reduces its Cooldown by 1 second.

140266583.name: Dodge
140266583.desc: Casting Death Trap grants you 50% Dodge Chance for 4 seconds.

140266584.name: Resolve
140266584.desc: Death Trap's damage is increased by 20%[x] while you have Resolve.

140266585.name: Weaken
140266585.desc: Death Trap makes enemies Weakened for 6 seconds.

2686060809.name: Sudden Death
2686060809.desc: Death Trap's arm time is reduced by 50%, and it deals a total of 280% damage in the area.  Casting Death Trap consumes 4 stack of Overpower to reduce arm time by 100% and increase its damage by 50%[x].

2686060810.name: Death Pit
2686060810.desc: Death Trap Pulls In enemies and makes them Vulnerable and Knocked Down for 4 seconds.  Death Trap gains 1 additional charge and has its Cooldown reduced by 15 seconds.

2686060811.name: Explosive Trigger
2686060811.desc: Death Trap is also a Grenade Skill.  Death Trap also releases 16 Stun Grenades that each explode for 20% damage.

432879.name: Bone Spear
desc: Conjure a bone spear from the ground that pierces enemies, dealing {val1}% damage.

582507894.name: Bone Spikes
582507894.desc: Bone Spear breaks into 3 piercing bone shards when it is destroyed, dealing 52.8% damage each.

582507895.name: Blood Spear
582507895.desc: Bone Spear becomes a Blood Skill that deals 160% damage.  Casting Bone Spear consumes a nearby Corpse and conjures a second Bone Spear from it, dealing 100% of normal damage.

582507896.name: Shadow Splitter
582507896.desc: Bone Spear becomes a Darkness Skill that deals 200% Shadow damage.  Instead of piercing through, Bone Spear forks into 2 piercing spears each time it hits an enemy or wall, up to 2 times.

2686060761.name: First Hit Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Bone Spear deals 40%[x] increased damage to the first enemy hit.

2686060762.name: Cost Reduction
2686060762.desc: Bone Spear's Essence cost is reduced by 5.

2686060763.name: Pierce Damage Bonus
2686060763.desc: Bone Spear deals 10%[x] increased damage per enemy pierced, up to 50%[x].

2686060764.name: Resolve
2686060764.desc: Bone Spear deals 5%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage per stack of Resolve, up to 40%[x].

432896.name: Reap
desc: Sweep an ethereal scythe in front of you, dealing {val1}% damage.

582507894.name: Harvest
582507894.desc: Reap sweeps a second time, dealing 25% damage and generating 7.5 Essence.

582507895.name: Cull The Weak
582507895.desc: Reap becomes a Blood Skill that deals 62.5% Physical damage.  Reap will Execute enemies and has a 50% chance to form a Blood Orb if they are killed by it.

582507896.name: Chilled To The Bone
582507896.desc: Reap deals 50% Cold damage and Chills for 15%.  Reap gains an additional 30% Cast Speed.

2686060761.name: Critical Strike Chance
2686060761.desc: Reap gains an additional 10% Critical Strike Chance.

2686060762.name: Essence Generation
2686060762.desc: Reap generates 2 additional Essence per enemy hit.

2686060763.name: Corpse Generation
2686060763.desc: Reap forms a Corpse under the first enemy hit.

2686060764.name: Ferocity
2686060764.desc: Reap grants 1 stack of Ferocity.

432897.name: Corpse Explosion
desc: Detonate a Corpse, dealing {val1}% damage to enemies.

582507894.name: Bloody Mess
582507894.desc: Corpse Explosion's Size is increased by 50% and damage is increased by 75%[x].

582507895.name: Miasma
