582507895.desc: Corpse Explosion is also a Darkness Skill and, instead of exploding, releases a vile miasma dealing 350% Corrupting damage over 6 seconds.

582507896.name: Shrapnel
582507896.desc: Corpse Explosion is also a Bone Skill and, instead of exploding, fires 8 piercing bone shards dealing 180% damage each.

2686060761.name: Multiple Corpses
2686060761.desc: Corpse Explosion detonates up to 2 additional corpses.

2686060762.name: Corpse Efficiency
2686060762.desc: Corpses consumed by Corpse Explosion can be consumed 1 additional time.

2686060763.name: Blood Orb
2686060763.desc: Corpse Explosion has a 20% chance to form a Blood Orb.

2686060764.name: Essence Generation
2686060764.desc: Casting Corpse Explosion generates 15 Essence.

439581.name: Claw
desc: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and claw at enemies dealing {val1}% Physical damage.

2686060761.name: Spirit
2686060761.desc: Claw restores an additional 10 Spirit.

2686060762.name: Ferocity
2686060762.desc: Gain 1 stack of Ferocity per cast when dealing damage.

2686060763.name: Cast Speed
2686060763.desc: Claw's Cast Speed is increased by 20%.

2686060764.name: Critical Strike Chance
2686060764.desc: Claw's Critical Strike Chance is increased by 10%.

2686060809.name: Viper Strikes
2686060809.desc: Claw attacks twice and deals 64% damage and an additional 28% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds to enemies hit.

2686060810.name: Lightning Claw
2686060810.desc: Claw is also a Storm Skill.  Claw deals 120% Lightning damage and enemies has a 20% chance to spawn 3 Dancing Bolts that deal 34.67% damage each.

2686060811.name: Dash
2686060811.desc: Claw now dashes you towards your target and deals 60% damage.

439762.name: Barrage
desc: Unleash a barrage of 5 arrows that expands outwards, each dealing {val1}% damage and piercing up to 2 times. Arrows cannot hit the same target more than once.
Combo Points increase damage and arrows fired:

140266582.name: Energy Cost Reduction
140266582.desc: Barrage's Energy Cost is reduced to 24.

140266583.name: Vulnerable or Weakened
140266583.desc: Barrage deals 20%[x] increased damage against Vulnerable or Weakened enemies.

140266584.name: Cast Speed
140266584.desc: Barrage gains 20% increased Cast Speed.

140266585.name: Overpower
140266585.desc: Casting Barrage consumes 1 stacks of Overpower to fire 2 additional arrows and all arrows to deal 20%[x] increased damage.

2686060809.name: Multishot
2686060809.desc: Barrage deals 170% damage and fires 2 additional arrows and all of its arrows now travel faster and pierce through 2 additional enemies.

2686060810.name: Broadside
2686060810.desc: Barrage no longer pierces and fires 2 less arrows. Its arrows each drop 1 Stun Grenade that deals 25% damage.

2686060811.name: Succession
2686060811.desc: Barrage fires arrows into the air, dealing 20% damage upon landing. Each arrow causes the enemy it hits to take 15%[x] increased damage from Barrage for the next 4 seconds, up to 75%[x]. Barrage now also creates an Arrow Storm, dealing 20% damage.

439912.name: Skeleton Warrior
desc: Passive: Raise a skeletal warrior from a nearby Corpse every 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 4 warriors. Skeletal warriors deal {val1}% with each attack.
Active: Command your skeletal warriors to leap at an enemy and attack.

582507894.name: Master of Puppets
582507894.desc: Skeleton Warrior's maximum number of warriors is increased by 3.

582507895.name: Service and Sacrifice
582507895.desc: Skeleton Warriors lose 25% of their Maximum Life per second while in combat and explode on death, dealing 150% damage.  Skeleton Warriors are now raised from a nearby Corpse every 0.5 seconds.

582507896.name: Litany of Death
582507896.desc: If all of your skeletal warriors have been Summoned, Skeleton Warrior briefly Summons a Skeleton Priest instead.  Skeleton Priest empowers your Minions for 8 seconds, increasing their Critical Strike Chance by 15% and healing them for 100% of their Maximum Life over the duration.

2686060761.name: Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Commanding your Skeleton Warriors causes them to deal 25%[x] increased damage for 10 seconds.

2686060762.name: Healing
2686060762.desc: Skeleton Warriors heal you for 2% of your Maximum Life (2) whenever they attack.

2686060763.name: Vulnerable
2686060763.desc: Skeleton Warriors have a 30% chance to make enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

2686060764.name: Resolve
2686060764.desc: Commanding your Skeleton Warriors grants 3 stacks of Resolve.

440313.name: Skeleton Mage
desc: Raise a skeletal mage, up to a maximum of 3 mages. Skeletal mages deal {val1}% damage with each attack.

582507894.name: Coven
582507894.desc: Skeleton Mage's maximum number of mages is increased by 2.

582507895.name: Gift of Death
582507895.desc: Skeleton Mage is also a Corpse Skill and requires a Corpse to be raised.  Each active skeletal mage increases your Essence Regeneration by 50%[x].

582507896.name: Singularity
582507896.desc: Skeleton Mage will consume all of your remaining Essence on cast to raise a more powerful but temporary mage.  The skeletal mage deals 3%[x] increased damage and lasts for 0.1 seconds for each point of Essence consumed.

2686060761.name: Duration Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Skeleton Mages deal 15%[x] increased damage. This bonus increases by 1% every second that the skeletal mage is alive, up to 25%[x].

2686060762.name: Critical Strike Chance
2686060762.desc: You gain an additional 5% Critical Strike Chance against enemies damaged by Skeleton Mages.

2686060763.name: Crowd Control Damage Bonus
2686060763.desc: Skeleton Mages deal 30%[x] increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.

2686060764.name: Ferocity, Resolve, or Overpower
2686060764.desc: Skeleton Mages have a 5% chance to grant 1 stack of Ferocity, Resolve, or Overpower whenever they attack based on whether your Skeleton Mage type is Shadow, Cold, or Bone respectively.

440463.name: Golem
desc: Passive: Raise a Golem that attacks for {val1}% damage. When your Golem dies, it respawns after 10 seconds.

Active: Command your Golem to leap to the target area. It becomes Unstoppable, Taunts Nearby enemies, and takes 30% reduced damage for the next 6 seconds. It gains 50% of its Armor as Thorns for the duration.

582507894.name: Gravebloom
582507894.desc: Golem now raises 3 smaller Golems that deal 60% of normal damage and gain 30% Attack Speed.

582507895.name: Fel Gluttony
582507895.desc: Commanding your Golem causes it to erupt, dealing 300% damage to surrounding enemies.  Your Golem passively consumes nearby Corpses every second to reduce its Cooldown by 2 seconds per Corpse consumed.

582507896.name: Gargantua
582507896.desc: Golem now raises a larger Golem that gains an aura of command, increasing the Cast Speed and Movement Speed of your other Minions by 20%[x].

2686060761.name: Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Golem deals 30%[x] increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.

2686060762.name: Unstoppable
2686060762.desc: Commanding your Golem also grants you Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

2686060763.name: Weaken
2686060763.desc: Golem Weakens enemies for 4 seconds whenever it attacks.

2686060764.name: Resolve, Overpower, or Ferocity
2686060764.desc: Commanding your Golem grants 3 stacks of Resolve, Overpower, or Ferocity based on whether your Golem type is Bone, Blood, or Iron respectively.

463175.name: Decompose
desc: Tear the flesh from an enemy, dealing {val1}% Corrupting damage per second and forming a usable Corpse with the flesh every 1 second.

582507894.name: Dry Rot
582507894.desc: Decompose chains to 3 additional enemies.

582507895.name: Putrid Burst
582507895.desc: Decompose causes a burst around the target every second, dealing an additional 112.5% damage to them and nearby enemies.

582507896.name: Rip and Tear
582507896.desc: Decompose becomes a Bone Skill that deals Physical damage.  Decompose now hits all other enemies in between you and the primary target.

2686060761.name: Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Decompose deals 50%[x] increased damage

2686060762.name: Barrier
2686060762.desc: Decompose grants a Barrier every second for 10% of your Maximum Life (3) that lasts 6 seconds.

2686060763.name: Crowd Control
2686060763.desc: Decompose Slows enemies by 50%.

2686060764.name: Lucky Hit Chance
2686060764.desc: Decompose has an additional 30% Lucky Hit Chance.

463349.name: Corpse Tendrils
desc: Burst veins out of a Corpse, Slowing enemies by 50% for 1.5 seconds before Pulling them in and dealing {val1}% damage.

582507894.name: Bitter Harvest
582507894.desc: Corpse Tendrils no longer consumes the Corpse. Enemies are Immobilized for 3 seconds after being Pulled in.

582507895.name: Get Over Here!
582507895.desc: Corpse Tendrils is no longer cast on a Corpse and is cast on you instead.  Corpse Tendrils Fortifies you for 5% of your Maximum Life (5) for each enemy it damages.

582507896.name: Jaws Of Death
582507896.desc: Corpse Tendrils now deals 100% damage and no longer has a delay before Pulling in enemies.

2686060761.name: Critical Strike Chance
2686060761.desc: You gain an additional 5% increased Critical Strike Chance for 6 seconds against enemies damaged by Corpse Tendrils.

2686060762.name: Essence Generation
2686060762.desc: Casting Corpse Tendrils generates 35 Essence.

2686060763.name: Vulnerable
2686060763.desc: Corpse Tendrils makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

2686060764.name: Lucky Hit Chance
2686060764.desc: Corpse Tendrils gains an additional 40% Lucky Hit Chance.

469641.name: Bone Spirit
desc: Conjure a spirit of bone that seeks enemies and explodes, dealing {val1}% damage.

582507894.name: Poltergeists
582507894.desc: When Bone Spirit explodes, it spawns 3 smaller spirits that seek enemies and explode for 30% damage each.

582507895.name: Unfinished Business
582507895.desc: Bone Spirit becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage.  Bone Spirit leaves behind a pool of Desecrated Ground when it explodes, dealing 250% Corrupting damage.

582507896.name: Astral Projection
582507896.desc: Bone Spirit no longer seeks enemies and instead spirals around you, piercing through enemies and exploding for 100% damage when it hits them.

2686060761.name: Charges
2686060761.desc: Bone Spirit gains 1 additional Charge and its Charge Cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

2686060762.name: Core Skill
2686060762.desc: Bone Spirit becomes a Core Skill, costs 30 Essence, and no longer has a Cooldown.  Bone Spirit will consume all of your remaining Essence on cast, dealing 3%[x] increased damage for each point of Essence consumed.

2686060763.name: Damage Bonus
2686060763.desc: Every second, your next Bone Spirit deals 10%[x] increased damage, up to 30%[x].

2686060764.name: Maximum Essence
2686060764.desc: Each enemy hit by Bone Spirit increases your Maximum Essence by 2 for 15 seconds, up to 20 Essence.

481293.name: Blight
desc: Unleash concentrated blight that deals {val1}% damage and leaves behind a defiled area, dealing {val2}% Corrupting damage over 6 seconds.

582507894.name: Piercing Darkness
582507894.desc: Blight pierces 1 time and can spawn an additional defiled area. Blight deals 75%[x] increased damage to Bosses.

582507895.name: Whirlpool
582507895.desc: Blight deals Cold and Frostbite damage and its Essence Cost is reduced by 10.  Its defiled area Pulls in enemies and Chills for 15% every second.

582507896.name: Volatile Blood
582507896.desc: Blight becomes a Blood skill that deals Physical damage.  Blight's defiled area instantly bursts, dealing 315% damage.

2686060761.name: Area Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Blight's defiled area deals 40%[x] increased damage.

2686060762.name: Size Bonus
2686060762.desc: Blight's Size is increased by 35%.

2686060763.name: Crowd Control Damage Bonus
2686060763.desc: Blight deals 30%[x] increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.

2686060764.name: Lucky Hit Chance
2686060764.desc: Blight has an additional 20% Lucky Hit Chance.

481785.name: Sever
desc: A specter of you charges forward, dealing {val1}% damage, then attacks with its scythe, dealing {val2}% damage.

582507894.name: Reaping Lotus
582507894.desc: Sever sends out 3 additional specters at its apex that expand out, dealing 60% damage each.

582507895.name: Inexorable Reaper
582507895.desc: Sever is also a Mobility Skill that dashes you forward to attack instead.

582507896.name: Cold Pursuit
582507896.desc: Sever deals Cold damage, Chills for 15%, and seeks another enemy to attack again.

2686060761.name: Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Sever deals 10%[x] increased damage, and an additional 1%[x] increased damage for each Minion you have.

2686060762.name: Cost Reduction
2686060762.desc: Sever's Essence cost is reduced by 4.

2686060763.name: Crowd Control and Corpse Generation
2686060763.desc: Sever Slows enemies by 40% for 3 seconds and forms a Corpse.

2686060764.name: Ferocity
2686060764.desc: Sever deals 7%[x] increased damage per stack of Ferocity.

484661.name: Hemorrhage
desc: Burst an enemy's blood, dealing {val1}% damage. Hemorrhage has a 20% chance to form a Blood Orb.

582507894.name: Blood Boil
582507894.desc: Hemorrhage also deals 40% damage to enemies around your target.

582507895.name: Blood Runs Cold
582507895.desc: Hemorrhage deals 80% Cold damage and Freezes enemies for 3 seconds. An enemy can be Frozen this way once every 6 seconds.  If Hemorrhage hits an enemy already Frozen, it has an additional 50% chance to form a Blood Orb.

582507896.name: Soul Rip
582507896.desc: Hemorrhage becomes a Darkness Skill that deals 80% Shadow damage.  Instead of forming a Blood Orb, Hemorrhage Summons a Volatile Skeleton that deals 120% damage.

2686060761.name: Cast Speed
2686060761.desc: Hemorrhage gains an additional 20% Cast Speed.

2686060762.name: Blood Orb
2686060762.desc: Hemorrhage has an additional 30% chance to form a Blood Orb.

2686060763.name: Weaken
2686060763.desc: Hemorrhage Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

2686060764.name: Overpower
2686060764.desc: Hemorrhage grants 1 stack of Overpower.

493422.name: Blood Mist
desc: Disperse into a bloody mist, becoming Immune for 3 seconds. You deal 420% damage to enemies and Heal for {val1}% of your Maximum Life ({val2}) over the duration.

582507894.name: Blood Transfusion
582507894.desc: Blood Mist Fortifies you for 30% of your Maximum Life (30) over its duration and forms a Blood Orb every second.

582507895.name: Blood Rush
582507895.desc: Blood Mist is now also a Mobility Skill and its Cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds.  Instead of dispersing you into a bloody mist, Blood Mist consumes a nearby corpse to teleport you to the target location and grants Unstoppable for 3.0 seconds.

582507896.name: Devouring Mist
582507896.desc: Blood Mist becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage.  Blood Mist now deals 600% Shadow damage over its duration and applies Vampiric Curse to enemies.

2686060761.name: Critical Strike
2686060761.desc: Blood Mist grants 5% Critical Strike Chance for 5 seconds after it ends.

2686060762.name: Movement Speed
2686060762.desc: Blood Mist increases your Movement Speed by 30%[x] for 3 seconds.

2686060763.name: Overpower
2686060763.desc: Blood Mist grants 1 stack of Overpower every second.

2686060764.name: Vulnerable and Slow
2686060764.desc: Blood Mist makes enemies Vulnerable and Slows them by 70% for 4 seconds.

493453.name: Bone Prison
desc: Unearth a prison of bone with {val1} Life that surrounds the target area for {val2} seconds.

582507894.name: Bramble
582507894.desc: You gain 348.88 Thorns for each enemy trapped by Bone Prison.  When a segment of Bone Prison is destroyed or expires, it deals 100% of your Thorns around itself.

582507895.name: Plunging Darkness
582507895.desc: Bone Prison becomes a Darkness Skill.  Bone Prison forms a Corpse every second and spawns a pool of Desecrated Ground, dealing 450% Corrupting damage.

582507896.name: Life Imprisonment
582507896.desc: Bone Prison becomes a Blood Skill, casting the prison around you.  While standing within it your Essence Generation and Cast Speed are increased by 20%, but it drains 5% of your Maximum Life every second.

2686060761.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060761.desc: Bone Prison reduces your active Cooldowns by 0.5 seconds for each enemy trapped, up to 5 seconds.

2686060762.name: Essence Generation
2686060762.desc: Casting Bone Prison generates 50 Essence. Trapping a Boss generates an additional 25 Essence.

2686060763.name: Vulnerable
2686060763.desc: Bone Prison makes enemies Vulnerable for 8 seconds.

2686060764.name: Resolve
2686060764.desc: Bone Prison grants 1 stack of Resolve for each enemy trapped.

497193.name: Army of the Dead
desc: Call forth the deep buried dead. Volatile Skeletons emerge over the next 7 seconds that explode when around enemies, dealing {val1}% damage and Stunning them for 2 seconds.

582507894.name: Unyielding Commander
582507894.desc: While Army of the Dead is active, your Minions take 90% reduced damage and deal 30%[x] increased damage.

582507895.name: Pile the Bodies
582507895.desc: Army of the Dead will converge on your target. Each time a Volatile Skeleton explodes on an enemy, they take 10%[x] increased damage from your Army of the Dead, up to 300%[x].

582507896.name: Dead Cold
582507896.desc: Army of the Dead now deals 150% Cold damage and Freezes enemies instead of Stunning them.

2686060761.name: Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Army of the Dead deals 2%[x] increased damage for each Minion you have.

2686060762.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060762.desc: Army of the Dead's Cooldown is reduced by 20 seconds.

2686060763.name: Passive Bonus
2686060763.desc: Army of the Dead passively summons a Volatile Skeleton every 4 seconds.

2686060764.name: Corpse Generation
2686060764.desc: Army of the Dead has a 50% chance to form a Corpse.

499281.name: Bone Storm
desc: A swirling storm of bones appears around you and your Golem, dealing {val1}% damage to surrounding enemies over 10 seconds.

582507894.name: Roll The Bones
582507894.desc: Bone Storm increases your Critical Strike Chance and Cast Speed by 15%.

582507895.name: Shadow And Bone
582507895.desc: Bone Storm becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage.  Enemies damaged by it suffer an additional 40% Corrupting damage over 2 seconds.

582507896.name: Hungry Cyclone
582507896.desc: Bone Storm is cast at the target location and seeks enemies. Its Cooldown is reduced by 20 seconds.

2686060761.name: Damage Reduction
2686060761.desc: Bone Storm increases your Damage Reduction by 10%.

2686060762.name: Duration Increase
2686060762.desc: Bone Storm consumes up to 4 corpses to increase its duration by 2 seconds per corpse.

2686060763.name: Vulnerable
2686060763.desc: Bone Storm makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

2686060764.name: Barrier
2686060764.desc: Casting Bone Storm grants a Barrier for 50% of your Maximum Life (50) for 10 seconds.

500962.name: Bone Splinters
desc: Fire 3 splinters of bone, dealing {val1}% damage each.

582507894.name: Bouncing Spines
582507894.desc: Bone Splinters now deals 45% damage with each splinter, bounces off walls, and travels further.

582507895.name: Bloody Splinter
582507895.desc: Bone Splinters becomes a Blood Skill that deals 30% damage and pierces 1 time.  Each time a splinter hits an enemy you Heal for 2.0% of your Maximum Life (2).

582507896.name: Shadow Seekers
582507896.desc: Bone Splinters becomes a Darkness Skill that deals 30% Shadow damage and seeks enemies.  When a splinter hits an enemy it causes a burst of shadow, dealing an additional 7.5% damage.

2686060761.name: Projectiles
2686060761.desc: Bone Splinters fires 1 additional splinter.

2686060762.name: Essence Generation
2686060762.desc: Bone Splinters generates 5 additional Essence.

2686060763.name: Vulnerable
2686060763.desc: Bone Splinters makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

2686060764.name: Resolve
2686060764.desc: Bone Splinters grants 1 stack of Resolve.

501629.name: Blood Lance
desc: Throw a blood lance, dealing {val1}% to an enemy that ricochets to another enemy. Enemies hit are lanced for 3 seconds.
When Blood Lance hits an enemy, it deals damage to all other lanced enemies.

582507894.name: Blood Seeker
582507894.desc: Blood Lance deals 50%[x] increased damage per lanced enemy, and an additional 50%[x] increased damage to the first enemy hit.

582507895.name: Gore Quills
582507895.desc: Every 3rd cast of Blood Lance forms a Blood Orb under the first enemy hit.  Casting Blood Lance will pick up a Blood Orb around you and conjure an additional lance from it, dealing 125% of normal damage.

582507896.name: Festering Wound
582507896.desc: Blood Lance becomes a Darkness Skill and deals Shadow damage.  Enemies hit are permanently lanced and the lance deals 100% Corrupting damage per second to them.

2686060761.name: Ricochet
2686060761.desc: Blood Lance ricochets to 1 additional enemy.

2686060762.name: Fortify
2686060762.desc: Blood Lance Fortifies you for 4% of your Maximum Life (4) if it hits an enemy already lanced.

2686060763.name: Cost Reduction
2686060763.desc: Blood Lance's Essence cost is reduced by 3.

2686060764.name: Overpower
2686060764.desc: Blood Lance consumes 2 stacks of Overpower to throw an additional lance, dealing 50% of normal damage.

512222.name: Iron Skin
desc: Steel yourself for 3 seconds, increasing your Maximum Life by 10% and gaining a Barrier that absorbs {val1}% of your Maximum Life ({val2}) in damage.

2686060761.name: Movement Speed
2686060761.desc: Iron Skin increases your Movement Speed by 15%[x].

2686060762.name: Weaken
2686060762.desc: Enemies attacking you while Iron Skin is active become Weakened for 3 seconds.

2686060763.name: Resolve
2686060763.desc: Iron Skin grants 2 stacks of Resolve when cast.

2686060764.name: Maximum Life
2686060764.desc: Increase the Maximum Life granted from Iron Skin to 15%.

2686060809.name: Juggernaut
2686060809.desc: Iron Skin also grants Unstoppable and enemies that hit you are Knocked back.

2686060810.name: Endure
2686060810.desc: Iron Skin no longer grants a Barrier, but your Life cannot be reduced below 1 for the duration and you are healed to 15.0% Life when Iron Skin expires.

2686060811.name: Retaliation
2686060811.desc: Iron Skin no longer grants a Barrier. Instead you reflect Iron Shrapnel when attacked, dealing 5% damage and inflicting 50% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.  Iron Skin's duration is tripled.

514030.name: Ball Lightning
desc: Discharge a ball of lightning that slowly moves forward and continuously zaps enemies, dealing {val1}% damage per second.

2686060761.name: Multiple Projectiles
2686060761.desc: Ball Lightning has a 20% chance to form a second Ball Lightning.

2686060762.name: Ferocity
2686060762.desc: Ball Lightning grants 1 stack of Ferocity.

2686060763.name: Crackling Energy
2686060763.desc: Ball Lightning forms 3 Crackling Energy when it dissipates.

2686060764.name: Damage Bonus
2686060764.desc: Ball Lightning deals 30%[x] increased damage when it hits 3 or fewer enemies.

2686060809.name: Attraction
2686060809.desc: Ball Lightning now deals 204% damage per second. The ball's speed is greatly increased while it is not near enemies.

2686060810.name: Orbital
2686060810.desc: Ball Lightning orbits you and now deals 144% damage around you per second.

2686060811.name: Implosion
2686060811.desc: Ball Lightning becomes a Pyromancy Skill, deals Fire damage, and has a 12 second Cooldown.  Ball Lightning is now cast at the target location and continuously Pulls In enemies, dealing 480% damage over 2 seconds.

517417.name: Unstable Currents
desc: Lightning surges within you for {val1} seconds. Whenever you Cast, trigger a random Skill:

2686060761.name: Ferocity
2686060761.desc: Unstable Currents increases your Minimum and Maximum Ferocity by 2.

2686060762.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060762.desc: Unstable Currents' Cooldown is reduced to 100 seconds.

2686060763.name: Damage Bonus
2686060763.desc: Unstable Currents increases your Shock Skill damage by 20%[x].

2686060764.name: Cost Reduction
2686060764.desc: Unstable Currents reduces your Mana costs by 5.

2686060809.name: Ramping Currents
2686060809.desc: Unstable Currents now has a 25% chance to trigger twice.

2686060810.name: Boundless
2686060810.desc: While Unstable Currents is active, gain the following bonuses: Lucky Hit: Up to a 25.0% chance to form a Crackling Energy Increases Crackling Energy damage by 2.5%[x] and reduces Unstable Currents' Cooldown by 0.10 seconds when absorbing Crackling Energy. Automatically absorb Nearby Crackling Energy.

2686060811.name: Thunder God
2686060811.desc: Unstable Currents now triggers equipped Shock Skills that deal 50%[x] increased damage, but the same Skill cannot be triggered more than once every 1 second.

543387.name: Earth Spike
desc: Sunder the earth, impaling all enemies hit for {val1}% damage.

1371751944.name: Werebear
1371751944.desc: Earth Spike becomes a Werebear Skill.

1372517862.name: Werewolf
1372517862.desc: Earth Spike becomes a Werewolf Skill.

1603373747.name: Human
1603373747.desc: Earth Spike's damage is increased by 10%[x].

2686060761.name: Spirit
2686060761.desc: Increase Earth Spike's Spirit generation by 8.

2686060762.name: Critical Strike Chance
2686060762.desc: Increase Earth Spike's Critical Strike Chance by 10%.

2686060763.name: Overpower
2686060763.desc: Earth Spike grants 1 stack of Overpower.

2686060764.name: Fortify
2686060764.desc: Earth Spike grants Fortify for 5% of your Maximum Life when hitting the first enemy.

2686060809.name: Megalith Stone
2686060809.desc: Hitting the same enemy with Earth Spike within 20 seconds deals 25%[x] increased damage and restores 1 additional Spirit. This effect stacks up to 3 times.

2686060810.name: Seismic Shift
2686060810.desc: Earth Spike launches spikes in a line in front of you dealing 70% of normal damage. Additionally, Earth Spike Slows enemies hit by 70% for 3 seconds.

2686060811.name: Aftershock
2686060811.desc: A second Earth Spike will appear at the previously targeted location dealing 80% of normal damage. This effect expires in 5 seconds.

548399.name: Lightning Storm
desc: Conjure a growing lightning storm that deals {val1}% damage per strike. The number of strikes increases the longer the storm is channeled, up to a maximum of 10 strikes at once. Lightning Storm may grow up to 5 times.
The size of your Lightning Storm is preserved for 4 seconds after channeling.

1372517862.name: Werewolf
1372517862.desc: Lightning Storm becomes a Werewolf Skill.

1603373747.name: Human
1603373747.desc: Lightning Storm's damage is increased by 10%[x].

2686060761.name: Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Lightning Storm's gains 10%[x] bonus damage. This bonus is increased to 25%[x] if the target is Vulnerable.

2686060762.name: Additional Strikes
2686060762.desc: Gain 1 additional Lightning Strike. Furthermore, each stack of Ferocity also grants 1 additional Lightning Strike, up to a maximum of 4 additional strikes.

2686060763.name: Minimum Strikes
2686060763.desc: Lightning Storm always grows from a baseline of 2 strikes.

2686060764.name: Movement Speed
2686060764.desc: The size of your Lightning Storm is preserved for an additional 4 seconds after channeling. In addition, you gain a 10%[x] Movement Speed bonus while Lightning Storm's size is preserved.

2686060809.name: Supercell
2686060809.desc: Lightning Storm may grow 1 additional time and each periodic gains 3 additional strikes.

2686060810.name: Omnibolt
2686060810.desc: All of your Lightning Strikes are combined into one powerful attack at the targeted location. Size is increased by 15% and damage is increased by 50%[x] per Lightning Strike.

2686060811.name: Hero of the Storm
2686060811.desc: Lightning Storm can be toggled passively and travels with you. Lightning Storm deals 91% damage and will be maintained as long as you have enough Spirit.  Cast Lightning Storm again to cancel this effect.

566517.name: Blood Howl
desc: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and howl furiously, Healing you for {val1}% of your Maximum Life ({val2}).

1603373747.name: Werewolf
1603373747.desc: Blood Howl's base healing is increased by 5%[x].

2686060761.name: Healing
2686060761.desc: For 5 seconds after casting Blood Howl, heal for 1% of your Maximum Life each time you hit an enemy.  These bonuses are doubled on Critical Strikes.

2686060762.name: Dodge Chance
2686060762.desc: Blood Howl increases your Dodge Chance by 20% for 5 seconds.

2686060763.name: Unstoppable
2686060763.desc: Blood Howl grants you Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

2686060764.name: Movement Speed
2686060764.desc: Blood Howl increases your Movement Speed by 15%[x] for 5 seconds.

2686060809.name: Hungering Howl
2686060809.desc: Blood Howl increases Healing Received from all sources by 50% for 5 seconds.

2686060810.name: Spirit Howl
2686060810.desc: Blood Howl instead restores 1 Spirit for every 1% of Life that would have been healed.

2686060811.name: Berserking Howl
2686060811.desc: Blood Howl grants Berserking to yourself and allies for 5 seconds and an additional 10%[x] increased damage to other Players for the duration. In addition, you deal 80% Poisoning damage over 4 seconds while Blood Howl is active.

592163.name: Blood Surge
desc: Draw blood from enemies, dealing {val1}% damage, then expel a blood nova, dealing {val2}% damage.
Blood Surge's nova damage is increased by 5%[x] for each enemy drawn from, up to 50%[x].

582507894.name: Bloodbath
582507894.desc: Blood Surge's nova echoes again after a short delay, dealing 125% damage.

582507895.name: You And What Army?
582507895.desc: Blood Surge expels smaller blood novas on your Minions, dealing 20% damage.  Blood Surge's minion nova damage is increased by 5%[x] for each enemy drawn from, up to 50%[x].

582507896.name: Pins and Needles
582507896.desc: Blood Surge becomes a Bone Skill and, instead of expelling a blood nova, expels 10 piercing bone shards dealing 60% damage each.  Instead of dealing increased damage, Blood Surge expels 1 additional shard for each enemy drawn from, up to 5 additional shards.

2686060761.name: Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Blood Surge deals 25%[x] increased damage while you are Healthy.

2686060762.name: Fortify
2686060762.desc: Blood Surge Fortifies you for 2% of your Maximum Life (2) for each enemy drawn from, up to 10%.

2686060763.name: Weaken
2686060763.desc: Blood Surge Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

2686060764.name: Overpower
2686060764.desc: Blood Surge consumes 2 stacks of Overpower to gain 25% increased Size and 50%[x] increased damage.

658216.name: Blood Wave
desc: Conjure a tidal wave of blood that deals {val1}% damage and Knocks Back enemies.

582507894.name: Tides of Blood
582507894.desc: Blood Wave launches 1 additional wave, dealing 500% damage.

582507895.name: Path of Darkness
582507895.desc: Blood Wave becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage.  Blood Wave leaves behind a trail of Desecrated Ground as it travels that deals 800% Corrupting damage.

582507896.name: Hematolagnia
582507896.desc: Blood Wave becomes a Core Skill, has no Cooldown, but costs 70 Essence.  Blood Wave conjures a shorter wave that deals 300% damage and no longer Knocks Back enemies.

2686060761.name: Damage Bonus
2686060761.desc: Blood Wave deals 30%[x] increased damage while you are Fortified.

2686060762.name: Damage Reduction
2686060762.desc: Casting Blood Wave grants 10% Damage Reduction for 10 seconds.

2686060763.name: Blood Orb
2686060763.desc: Blood Wave forms up to 2 Blood Orbs as it travels.

2686060764.name: Overpower
2686060764.desc: Casting Blood Wave overfills your Overpower by 2.

786381.name: Dark Shroud
desc: Surround yourself with up to 5 protective shadows. Gain {val1}% Resistance to All Elements per active shadow. If you have the maximum amount of shadows, direct damage is reduced by 20.0%. Each time you take direct damage, a shadow is consumed.

140266582.name: Movement Speed
140266582.desc: Each active Dark Shroud shadow grants you 5%[x] Movement Speed.

140266583.name: Critical Strike
140266583.desc: While you have at least 1 active shadow from Dark Shroud, gain 5% Critical Strike Chance.

140266584.name: Consume Chance
140266584.desc: Dark Shroud shadows have a 15% chance to not be consumed.

140266585.name: Healing
140266585.desc: You Heal for 10% of your Maximum Life when a Dark Shroud shadow is consumed.

2686060809.name: Shadow Dancer
2686060809.desc: Casting Dark Shroud increases your Dodge Chance by 50% for 2 seconds. While you have at least 1 active shadow from Dark Shroud, gain 10.0% Dodge Chance.

2686060810.name: Overflow
2686060810.desc: Dark Shroud no longer grants Resistance to All Elements, but instead grants you 15%[x] increased Energy Regeneration per shadow.

2686060811.name: Best Served Cold
2686060811.desc: When a Dark Shroud shadow is consumed, it explodes in a frigid nova that deals 60% Cold damage to surrounding enemies and Chills them for 30%.

794965.name: Concealment
desc: Vanish from sight, gaining an advanced form of Stealth for 5 seconds that will not be removed by taking damage.
Concealment also makes you Unstoppable, grants {val1}% Movement Speed, and Unhindered for its duration.
Using an attack Skill during Concealment will break Concealment.

140266582.name: Energy
140266582.desc: Casting Concealment generates 40 Energy.

140266583.name: Resolve
140266583.desc: Casting Concealment grants 4 stacks of Resolve.

140266584.name: Unstoppable
140266584.desc: Unstoppable persists for 4 seconds after breaking Concealment when Cast.

140266585.name: Ferocity
140266585.desc: Gain 2 stacks of Ferocity after breaking Concealment when Cast.

2686060809.name: Calculation
2686060809.desc: Casting Concealment grants 4 stacks of Overpower. After breaking Concealment, you gain 10.0% increased Critical Strike Chance for the next 6 seconds.

2686060810.name: Recuperate
2686060810.desc: Entering Concealment Fortifies you for 20.0% of your Maximum Life over 5 seconds. Breaking Concealment Knocks Down Close enemies for 2 seconds.

2686060811.name: Concealing Fate
2686060811.desc: When you break Concealment, all Nearby enemies are covered in a shadowy mist for 4 seconds, causing them to become Vulnerable and explode for 150% Shadow damage when it expires.

915150.name: Decrepify
desc: Curse the target area. Enemies afflicted by Decrepify are Weakened and Slowed by {val1}% for 30 seconds.

582507894.name: Dizzying Curse
582507894.desc: The first time an enemy is afflicted with Decrepify they are Dazed for 3.0 seconds.

582507895.name: Life Tap
582507895.desc: Decrepify is also a Blood Skill, healing for 10.0% of your Maximum Life (10) whenever you hit an enemy afflicted with it, up to once a second.  Enemies that die while afflicted with Decrepify have a 20% chance to form a Blood Orb.

582507896.name: Unholy Frenzy
582507896.desc: Instead of afflicting enemies Decrepify is now applied to your Minions, granting them 20%[x] increased Cast Speed and Movement Speed.

2686060761.name: Critical Strike Chance
2686060761.desc: You have an additional 5% Critical Strike Chance against enemies afflicted with Decrepify.

2686060762.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060762.desc: Lucky Hit: Enemies hit while afflicted with Decrepify have up to a 15% chance to reduce a random active Cooldown by 1 second.

2686060763.name: Movement Speed
2686060763.desc: Each enemy afflicted with Decrepify increases your Movement Speed by 2%[x].

2686060764.name: Resolve
2686060764.desc: Lucky Hit: Enemies hit while afflicted with Decrepify have up to a 25% chance to grant 1 stack of Resolve.

915152.name: Iron Maiden
desc: Curse the target area. Enemies afflicted by Iron Maiden take {val1}% damage every 2 seconds and {val2}% damage each time they deal direct damage for 30 seconds.

582507894.name: Schadenfreude
582507894.desc: While at least 1 enemy is afflicted with Iron Maiden, you gain 3,488.81 Thorns.  Iron Maiden's damage is increased by 100% of your Thorns.

582507895.name: Torture Artist
582507895.desc: Iron Maiden is also a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage.  Enemies have 30% chance to be stunned for 2 seconds when they take damage from Iron Maiden.

582507896.name: Blood Maiden
582507896.desc: Iron Maiden is also a Blood Skill, causing enemies damaged by it to have a 5% chance to form a Blood Orb.  Casting Iron Maiden picks up 4 Blood Orbs in the target area and causes them to burst for 150% damage.

2686060761.name: Essence Generation
2686060761.desc: Iron Maiden no longer has an Essence cost and instead generates 5 Essence for each enemy you curse that was not already afflicted with Iron Maiden.

2686060762.name: Execute and Fortify
2686060762.desc: Enemies afflicted with Iron Maiden will be Executed.  You are Fortified for 5% of your Maximum Life (5) when an enemy dies while afflicted with Iron Maiden.

2686060763.name: Vulnerable
2686060763.desc: Enemies afflicted with Iron Maiden are Vulnerable.

2686060764.name: Ferocity and Overpower
2686060764.desc: Lucky Hit: Enemies hit while afflicted with Iron Maiden have up to a 15% chance to randomly grant 1 stack of Ferocity or Overpower.

964631.name: Steel Grasp
desc: Throw out a trio of chains that deal {val1}% damage and Pull In enemies.

2686060761.name: Berserking
2686060761.desc: Steel Grasp grants Berserking for 2 seconds on Hit.

2686060762.name: Extra Charges
2686060762.desc: Steel Grasp gains 2 Charges.

2686060763.name: Vulnerable
2686060763.desc: Steel Grasp makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

2686060764.name: Weaken
2686060764.desc: Steel Grasp Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

2686060809.name: Chain Whip
2686060809.desc: Steel Grasp is also a Brawling Skill that launches 2 additional chains for 65% damage.

2686060810.name: Devil's Chain
2686060810.desc: Steel Grasp gains 2 additional Charges and forms 3 Dust Devils dealing 25% damage.

2686060811.name: Solo Chain
2686060811.desc: Steel Grasp becomes a Basic Skill that has no Cooldown, generates up to 15 Fury based on Charges, but only throws a single chain.

1256958.name: Shred
desc: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and perform a trio of combo attacks:
3rd Attack: Perform a larger finishing move dealing {val3}% damage.

2686060761.name: Berserking
2686060761.desc: Shred grants Berserking for 1 seconds. Subsequent casts extend this duration up to a maximum of 4 seconds.

2686060762.name: Healing
2686060762.desc: Shred Heals for 3% of your Maximum Life (3) if an enemy is struck.  Healing is increased to 6% of your Maximum Life (6) when striking a Poisoned enemy.

2686060763.name: Spirit
2686060763.desc: Critical Strikes with Shred restore 1 Spirit.  Striking a Poisoned enemy instead grants 2 Spirit.

2686060764.name: Cast Speed
2686060764.desc: Shred's Cast Speed is increased by 20%.

2686060809.name: Storm Shred
2686060809.desc: Your Claws are electrically charged allowing Shred to deal 80%[x] bonus damage as Lightning.  Shred becomes a Storm Skill.

2686060810.name: Roundhouse
2686060810.desc: Shred's third combo attack becomes a powerful 360 degree swipe that deals 720% damage.

2686060811.name: Critical Shred
2686060811.desc: Shred's first attack gains a 100% Critical Strike Chance and 50% Critical Strike Damage bonus.

1473878.name: Stone Burst
desc: Gather stones beneath your enemies then detonate them dealing {val1}% damage.
Channeling deals 20% damage and increases the size of the affected area, up to a 200% radius increase over 1 seconds.

1371751944.name: Werebear
1371751944.desc: Stone Burst becomes a Werebear Skill.

1603373747.name: Human
1603373747.desc: Stone Burst's damage is increased by 10%[x].

2686060761.name: Growth Speed
2686060761.desc: Increase Stone Burst's growth speed by 30%.

2686060762.name: Spirit Cost Reduction
2686060762.desc: Reduce the Spirit cost for casting Stone Burst by 6.

2686060763.name: Armor
2686060763.desc: Gain 30% Armor while Stone Burst is channeling.

2686060764.name: Fortify
2686060764.desc: When Stone Burst reaches its maximum size, gain Fortify for 35% of your Maximum Life.

2686060809.name: Epicenter
2686060809.desc: Stone Burst Slows enemies within the area by 80%. Additionally, each time Stone Burst grows larger, it marks the enemies in the area for 40% bonus damage from Stone Burst's final explosion, this bonus can stack on enemies and all stacks are consumed at final explosion.

2686060810.name: Rumbling Stones
2686060810.desc: Stone Burst can be channeled infinitely. After reaching the maximum size, continually channeling Stone Burst will periodically detonate, dealing the final explosion damage and consuming 10 Spirit.

2686060811.name: Living Stones
2686060811.desc: Stone Burst is cast at the targeted location and grows by itself, detonating after 3 seconds. Only 1 Stone Burst may be active at a time.

1489641.name: Vortex
desc: Create a cyclone that Pulls enemies inward followed by a crushing downdraft that deals {val1}% damage to them.

140266582.name: Cooldown Reduction
140266582.desc: Critical Strikes with Vortex reduce its Cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

140266583.name: Vigor Generation
140266583.desc: Casting Vortex generates 20 Vigor.

140266584.name: Knock Down
140266584.desc: Vortex Knocks Down enemies for 2 seconds.

140266585.name: Damage Increase
140266585.desc: Vortex deals 50%[x] increased damage.

2686060809.name: Overcharged
2686060809.desc: Vortex makes enemies Vulnerable for 4.0 seconds and Sparks enemies for 200% damage over 2 seconds.

2686060810.name: 1000 Year Storm
2686060810.desc: Vortex deals 200%[x] increased damage, affects a 50% larger area, and grants 20% Damage Reduction for 5 seconds, but its Cooldown is increased by 5 seconds.

2686060811.name: Insect Swarm
2686060811.desc: Vortex is also a Centipede Skill that deals Poison damage.  Vortex creates a wave of insects that swarm around you, dealing 20% damage and Slowing enemies by 90% for 5 seconds. They create a Poison nova, damaging enemies for 175% damage over 5 seconds.

1519048.name: Quill Volley
desc: Hurl 5 feathers that pierce through enemies, each dealing {val1}% damage.

140266582.name: Vulnerable Damage
140266582.desc: Quill Volley makes enemies Vulnerable. If they are already Vulnerable, Quill Volley deals 20% more damage.

140266583.name: Bonus Feathers
140266583.desc: Quill Volley hurls out 2 additional feathers. Consume 2 Nearby Storm Feathers to shoot out 2 more.

140266584.name: Returning Feathers
140266584.desc: Quill Volley costs 100% more Vigor and the feathers return after reaching their Max distance.

140266585.name: Evade Damage
140266585.desc: Quill Volley deals 20% increased damage when Cast within 5 seconds of Evading.

2686060809.name: Volatile Feathers
2686060809.desc: Quill Volley's feathers explode at their apex, dealing 30% damage.

2686060810.name: Quill Command
2686060810.desc: Quill Volley's feathers fly 50% further and converge on your target, dealing 100%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage.

2686060811.name: Claw Volley
2686060811.desc: Quill Volley is also a Jaguar skill that deals Fire damage and costs 10 less Vigor.  Quill Volley sends out 3 piercing claws that deal 43.75% damage twice.

1519050.name: Crushing Hand
desc: Smash down next to you with devastating force, creating 2 shockwaves on either side that overlap and each deal {val1}% damage.

140266582.name: Block to Damage
140266582.desc: Blocking increases the damage of Crushing Hand by 5%[x] for 5 seconds, up to 25%[x].

140266583.name: Barrier
140266583.desc: Crushing Hand grants a Barrier for 5% of your Maximum Life (5) for 3 seconds, up to 30% (30).

140266584.name: Increased Cost and Damage
140266584.desc: Crushing Hand costs 100% more Vigor but deals 50%[x] more damage.

140266585.name: Resolve
140266585.desc: Crushing Hand grants Resolve.

2686060809.name: Unrelenting Assault
2686060809.desc: Every 3rd Crushing Hand smashes 12 additional times dealing 36% damage each.

2686060810.name: Heavy Hitter
2686060810.desc: Crushing Hand smashes a single time in a smaller area in front of you, dealing 360% damage and 150% of your Thorns.

2686060811.name: 100 Crushing Hands
2686060811.desc: Crushing Hand is also a Centipede Skill that deals Poison damage.  Crushing Hand sends centipedes scuttling across the ground, Poisoning enemies for 360% damage over 6 seconds. Enemies Poisoned from Crushing Hand are Weakened.

1611316.name: Mighty Throw
desc: Hurl your weapon, dealing {val1}% damage upon impact and sticking in the ground. While in the ground, your weapon pulses and deals {val2}% damage every second for 4.02 seconds.

2686060761.name: Barrier
2686060761.desc: Mighty Throw generates up to 15% of your Maximum Life (15) as a Barrier for 6 seconds.

2686060762.name: Size Bonus
2686060762.desc: Increase Mighty Throw's damage radius by 20%.

2686060763.name: Ferocity
2686060763.desc: Grants 3 stacks of Ferocity each time you use Mighty Throw.

2686060764.name: Overpower
2686060764.desc: Mighty Throw now consumes one of your Overpower stacks to deal 20%[x] increased damage.

2686060809.name: Spares
2686060809.desc: Mighty Throw hurls another 2 weapons, dealing 136.5% damage upon impact, and pulses for 65% damage.

2686060810.name: Rapid
2686060810.desc: Swapping weapons near any of Mighty Throw's thrown weapons creates an additional pulse for 50% damage.

2686060811.name: Mightiest
2686060811.desc: Mighty Throw is now an Ultimate Skill that drops a massive weapon for 542.5% damage with a 6 second cooldown.  This cooldown cannot be reduced by Cooldown Reduction.

1627075.name: Familiar
desc: Summon a Fire Familiar for 8 seconds. It seeks enemies and periodically explodes, dealing {val1}% damage.
You may have up to 6 Familiars active at a time.

2686060761.name: Charge
2686060761.desc: Familiar gains 1 additional Charge.

2686060762.name: Size Bonus
2686060762.desc: Familiar's explosion radius is increased by 50%.

2686060763.name: Duration Bonus
2686060763.desc: Familiar's duration is increased by 4 seconds.

2686060764.name: Bonus Effect
2686060764.desc: Gain a bonus based on the Familiar type when the Familiar explodes:  Fire Familiar  Gain 5% Healing Received for 5 seconds. Cold Familiar  Gain a Barrier for 5% of your Maximum Life (5) for 5 seconds, up to 30%. Lightning Familiar  Reduce a random active Cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

2686060809.name: Healing Flames
2686060809.desc: Casting Familiar grants 1 stack of Overpower and restores 1.0% of your Maximum Life (1) per second while active.

2686060810.name: Fast As Lightning
2686060810.desc: Familiar becomes a Shock Skill that deals Lightning damage.  Familiar increases your Minimum Ferocity by 1 and grants 2.00% Cooldown Reduction while active.

2686060811.name: Freezing Familiar
2686060811.desc: Familiar becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage.  Familiar Chills for 15% and Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

2686060812.name: Prismatic Familiar
2686060812.desc: Familiar becomes a Pyromancy, Shock, and Frost Skill that summons a stationary Prismatic Familiar.  Casting Skills will cause Prismatic Familiar to apply 105% Frostbite, Sparking, or Burning damage over 4 seconds to surrounding enemies based on the Element Cast.

1640931.name: Rake
desc: Conjure claws that rake through enemies in front of you, dealing {val1}% damage before exploding for an additional {val2}% damage.

140266582.name: Ferocity
140266582.desc: Casting Rake grants a stack of Ferocity.

140266583.name: Cast Speed
140266583.desc: Rake gains 20% Cast Speed.

140266584.name: Cooldown Reduction
140266584.desc: Hitting at least one enemy with Rake reduces your longest active Cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

140266585.name: Cost Reduction and Damage
140266585.desc: For each stack of Ferocity you have, Rake's Vigor cost is reduced by 2 and its initial hit's damage is increased by 5%.

2686060809.name: Spirit Jaguar
2686060809.desc: Rake manifests a spirit Jaguar which rakes a random enemy dealing 50% damage before exploding for 65% damage.

2686060810.name: Grasping Claw
2686060810.desc: Rake is 20% larger. Rake's initial hit pulls in enemies at its edge and hits enemies again for 75% damage.  If Rake only hits a single target, it deals 100%[x] increased damage.

2686060811.name: Simian Swipe
2686060811.desc: Rake is also a Gorilla Skill that deals Physical damage.  Rake sweeps in front of you, dealing 218.75% damage and gaining a stack of Resolve if you hit an enemy.

1644584.name: Soulrift
desc: Consume surrounding enemies, dealing {val1}% Corrupting damage over 8 seconds.
Every 0.25 seconds you absorb the souls of 3 enemies, gaining 2 Essence per enemy. You absorb 3 souls at a time from Bosses.

582507894.name: Distilled Anima
582507894.desc: While Soulrift is active, your Darkness damage is increased by 30%[x].

582507895.name: Soul Vortex
582507895.desc: Soulrift is cast at the target location and its Cooldown is reduced by 15 seconds. Absorbing an enemy's soul deals 25% damage and Pulls them in.

582507896.name: Frozen Wasteland
582507896.desc: Soulrift deals Frostbite damage and Chills for 30% every second.  If Soulrift absorbs the soul of a Frozen enemy, they shatter and explode for 75% damage.

2686060761.name: Movement Speed
2686060761.desc: While Soulrift is active you are Unhindered and gain 1% increased Movement Speed for every soul absorbed, up to 40%.  This bonus persists for 5 seconds after Soulrift ends.

2686060762.name: Barrier
2686060762.desc: Every soul absorbed by Soulrift grants a Barrier for 0.5% of your Maximum Life (1).  This Barrier persists for 5 seconds after Soulrift ends.

2686060763.name: Vulnerable and Crowd Control
2686060763.desc: When Soulrift absorbs an enemy's soul it makes them Vulnerable for 4 seconds.  After Soulrift ends, all surrounding enemies are Feared and Slowed by 85% for 5 seconds.

2686060764.name: Ferocity
2686060764.desc: Every 30 souls absorbed by Soulrift grants 1 stack of Ferocity.

1663204.name: The Seeker
desc: The Eagle Spirit swoops down and deals {val1}% damage. After a short delay it blasts off dealing {val2}% damage.

140266582.name: Vulnerable
140266582.desc: The Seeker constantly makes all enemies in its area Vulnerable.

140266583.name: Charge Refund
140266583.desc: Elites hit twice by The Seeker have a 25% chance to refund a Charge, doubled against Bosses.

140266584.name: Vigor Generation
140266584.desc: Casting The Seeker restores 25 Vigor.

140266585.name: Storm Feathers
140266585.desc: The Seeker drops 5 Storm Feathers when it swoops down.

2686060809.name: Stormbringer
2686060809.desc: The Seeker's first hit Knocks Down enemies for 4 seconds and leaves behind a Spirit Storm that Sparks enemies for 240% damage

2686060810.name: Lone Seeker
2686060810.desc: The Seeker now only has 1 Charge, its area is increased by 50%, and it deals 250% increased damage.

2686060811.name: Tag Team
2686060811.desc: The Seeker is also a Jaguar Skill.  The Jaguar Spirit aids The Seeker, granting you 4 Ferocity and slashing 3 times dealing 75% Fire Damage. The Seeker gains 2 additional Charges.

1663206.name: The Hunter
desc: Bound across the battlefield with the Jaguar Spirit, dealing {val1}% damage upon landing and then rapidly slashing enemies in the area for {val2}% total damage over 7 strikes.

140266582.name: Execute
140266582.desc: The Hunter's landing damage will Execute enemies.

140266583.name: Healing
140266583.desc: The Hunter restores 3% of your Maximum Health per strike.

140266584.name: Size Bonus
140266584.desc: The Hunter strikes a 50% larger area.

140266585.name: Vigor Generation
140266585.desc: Casting The Hunter generates 25 Vigor.

2686060809.name: Relentless Pursuit
2686060809.desc: The Hunter overfills your Ferocity by 2 stacks. Killing enemies while with it active has a 40% chance to instantly reset its Cooldown. This chance is halved after each consecutive reset.

2686060810.name: Shredder
2686060810.desc: The Hunter strikes an additional 5 times and consumes all of your Ferocity to deal 20%[x] increased damage per Ferocity.

2686060811.name: Push and Pounce
2686060811.desc: The Hunter is also a Gorilla Skill.  The Gorilla Spirit knocks enemies towards The Hunter's landing spot, dealing 150% Physical damage and Knocking Down enemies on landing for 2 seconds. Each enemy you damage with The Hunter grants Resolve, which can overfill your Resolve by 4 stacks.

1663208.name: The Protector
desc: The Gorilla Spirit protects an area for 6 seconds, continuously smashing surrounding enemies for {val1}% damage and granting you Barrier for 10% of your Maximum Life (10) every 1.5 seconds.

140266582.name: Damage Increase
140266582.desc: The Protector deals 30% increased damage.

140266583.name: Barrier
140266583.desc: The Protector grants an additional 10% of your Maximum Life in Barrier.

140266584.name: Resolve Generation
140266584.desc: The Protector grants 2 Resolve when it smashes.

140266585.name: Thorns Damage
140266585.desc: The Protector's area deals 350%[x] of your Thorns damage to enemies within every 1.5 seconds.

2686060809.name: Canopy Shelter
2686060809.desc: The Protector's area persists for an additional 6 seconds and Slows enemies and Small Missiles by 80%. While inside, you are Unstoppable.

2686060810.name: Brutal Barrage
2686060810.desc: The Protector also deals 175% damage to enemies around you with each smash. Spend up to 3 stacks of Resolve to increase The Protector's damage by 100% for each stack spent.

2686060811.name: The Infected Forest
2686060811.desc: The Protector is also a Centipede Skill.  The Centipede Spirit aids The Protector, poisoning enemies for 100% damage each second, Weakening them, and spawning Pestilent Swarms that deal 100% damage.

1663210.name: The Devourer
desc: The Centipede Spirit emerges, blasting enemies in a line for {val1}% damage and spitting at others for {val2}% damage. Lasts for 15 seconds.

140266582.name: Instant Kill
140266582.desc: While The Devourer is active, if a Non-Boss enemy's remaining Life becomes Poisoned, they die instantly.

140266583.name: Poisoning Duration
140266583.desc: While The Devourer is active, your Poisoning effects have 20% increased duration.

140266584.name: Healing
140266584.desc: The Devourer Heals you for 5% of your Maximum Life (5) per second.

140266585.name: Thorns
140266585.desc: The Devourer grants you 50% increased Thorns for 15 seconds.

2686060809.name: Spew Putrefaction
2686060809.desc: As it emerges, The Devourer launches 10 toxic globs that apply 35% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds wherever they land. Enemies affected by toxic globs also take 50%[x] increased Poison Damage.

2686060810.name: Blast of Bile
2686060810.desc: The Devourer now only blasts enemies in a line once, dealing 800% damage, before leaving.  The Devourer is now also a Potency Skill and has a 18 second cooldown.

2686060811.name: Sky and Soil
2686060811.desc: The Devourer is also an Eagle Skill.  The Eagle Spirit aids The Devourer, creating a Lightning Storm that Sparks enemies for 80% damage each second and makes enemies Vulnerable. Gain 20% Movement Speed while The Devourer is active.

1690398.name: Dance of Knives
desc: Channel to launch knives at surrounding enemies with each knife dealing {val1}% damage. Attack Speed increases damage done rather than number of knives thrown.
Combo Points increase damage and grant a Movement Speed bonus for 4 seconds.

140266582.name: Energy Cost Reduction
140266582.desc: Dance of Knives' Energy Cost is reduced to 20.

140266583.name: Lucky Hit
140266583.desc: Dance of Knives gains 20%[x] increased Lucky Hit Chance.

140266584.name: Slow and Movement Speed
140266584.desc: Dance of Knives Slows enemies hit by 25% for 4 seconds and grants 12%[x] Movement Speed while Channeling.

140266585.name: Pierce and Size
140266585.desc: Dance of Knives' knives has a 33% chance to pierce and grenades' explosion area is increased by 25%.

2686060809.name: Star Shards
2686060809.desc: Knives have a 50% chance to shatter into 6 shards of metal on hit, dealing 26% damage.  Dance of Knives becomes a Marksman Skill.

2686060810.name: Fan of Knives
2686060810.desc: Dance of Knives now throws a fan of 5 knives that each deal 36.4% damage.

2686060811.name: Grenade Jumper
2686060811.desc: Dance of Knives now drops grenades instead of knives, each dealing 104%.  Dance of Knives is also a Grenade Skill.

1817045.name: Rock Splitter
desc: Rush at a target and clobber enemies in front of you, dealing {val1}% damage.
Your 3rd attack strikes enemies around you, dealing {val2}% damage.

140266582.name: Block and Vigor
140266582.desc: Rock Splitter increases your Block Chance by 15% for 5 seconds and when you Block you gain 15 Vigor.

140266583.name: Crowd Control Damage
140266583.desc: Rock Splitter deals 20%[x] increased damage when hitting a Slowed or Knocked Down enemy.

140266584.name: Free Strike
140266584.desc: Every 5 times you Block, automatically cast Rock Splitter's 3rd attack.

140266585.name: Resolve
140266585.desc: Rock Splitter grants Resolve.

2686060809.name: Shattered Stone
2686060809.desc: Rock Splitter increases your Thorns by 3,489 for 5 seconds and your 3rd attack deals 100% of your Thorns to enemies.

2686060810.name: Unbreakable
2686060810.desc: Rock Splitter's 3rd attack grants a Barrier for 5% of your Maximum Life (5) for 5 seconds and generates Resolve.

2686060811.name: Inner Ferocity
2686060811.desc: Rock Splitter is also a Jaguar Skill that deals Fire damage.  Rock Splitter's 3rd attack hits twice, dealing 100% damage each hit. If you have 4 stacks of Ferocity, hit an additional time.

1834471.name: Withering Fist
desc: Dart at and jab an enemy several times, dealing a total of {val1}% damage and applying {val2}% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds.
Your 3rd attack bursts on your target, damaging surrounding enemies and Slowing them by 40% for 3 seconds.

140266582.name: Vigor Generation
140266582.desc: You gain 5 Vigor per second for every Nearby enemy Poisoned by Withering Fist, up to 10.

140266583.name: Healing
140266583.desc: Withering Fist Heals you for 10% of your Maximum Life (10).

140266584.name: Weakened
140266584.desc: Enemies Poisoned by Withering Fist are Weakened.

140266585.name: Poisoning Duration
140266585.desc: Withering Fist's Poisoning duration is increased by 2 seconds.

2686060809.name: Shared Suffering
2686060809.desc: Withering Fist's 3rd attack spreads its Poisoning to 5 Nearby enemies and Slows them for 40% more.

2686060810.name: Precision Strike
2686060810.desc: Withering Fist's 3rd attack's burst is 30% smaller, but deals 600% increased Poisoning damage and applies Vulnerable.

2686060811.name: Fist of the Forest
2686060811.desc: Withering Fist is also a Gorilla Skill that deals Physical damage.  Withering Fist's 3rd attack releases a shockwave that deals 150% damage. It grants Barrier equal to 5% of your Maximum Health (5) for 6 seconds per enemy hit, up to 60% (60).

1834473.name: Thrash
desc: Dive at an enemy and slash into it dealing {val1}% damage.
Your 3rd attack unleashes a rapid series of slashes around your target, dealing a total of {val2}% damage.

140266582.name: Vigor Generation
140266582.desc: Killing an enemy empowers your next Thrash to generate 10 additional Vigor. This stacks up to the next 10 Casts of Thrash.

140266583.name: Ferocity
140266583.desc: Thrash's 3rd attack grants 2 stacks of Ferocity.

140266584.name: Cooldown Reduction
140266584.desc: Each hit of Thrash has a 10% chance to reduce an active Cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

140266585.name: Ramping Damage
140266585.desc: Each hit of Thrash increases the damage that enemy takes from Thrash by 2%[x], stacking up to 30%[x].

2686060809.name: Wanton Rampage
2686060809.desc: Thrash's 1st and 2nd attacks have a 30% chance to also unleash its 3rd attack that is 40% larger and deals 20%[x] increased damage.

2686060810.name: Crashing and Thrashing
2686060810.desc: Thrash's 3rd attack deals 50%[x] increased damage. Thrash continues to unleash its 3rd attack if Cast again within 2.5 seconds.

2686060811.name: Storm Conjurer
2686060811.desc: Thrash is also an Eagle Skill that deals Lightning damage.  Thrash's 3rd attack deals 135% damage and creates a moving Spirit Storm that Sparks enemies for 200% damage.

1834476.name: Thunderspike
desc: Quickly jab forward with a piercing strike dealing {val1}% damage.
Your 3rd attack pierces further, dealing {val2}% damage.

140266582.name: Vigor Generation
140266582.desc: Thunderspike generates 7 additional Vigor if you have moved in the last 2 seconds.

140266583.name: Critical Strike
140266583.desc: After you Critically Strike 15 times, Thunderspike's next use will be its 3rd attack and always Critically Strike.

140266584.name: Damage to Sparking
140266584.desc: Thunderspike deals 50% increased damage to Sparking enemies.

140266585.name: Movement Speed
140266585.desc: Thunderspike increases your Movement Speed by 15%[x] for 5 seconds.

2686060809.name: Lightning's Grip
2686060809.desc: Thunderspike's 3rd attack strikes back again for 90% damage, Pulling in and applying Vulnerable to enemies.

2686060810.name: Lightning Dancer
2686060810.desc: When you Evade, you attack with Thunderspike along the way for 100% of normal damage.

2686060811.name: Infected Ground
2686060811.desc: Thunderspike is also a Centipede Skill that deals Poison damage.  Thunderspike leaves a trail of poison that deals 60% damage over 6 seconds.

1836008.name: Stinger
desc: Strike a small area, dealing {val1}% damage to enemies within as well as all surrounding Poisoned enemies.

140266582.name: Healing and Vulnerable
140266582.desc: If Stinger strikes a Vulnerable enemy it Heals you for 10% of your Maximum Life (10). If you are Healthy it makes enemies Vulnerable for 3 seconds.

140266583.name: Damage Bonus
140266583.desc: Stinger's initial impact deals 30% increased damage.

140266584.name: Size Bonus
140266584.desc: Stinger's area is 100% bigger.

140266585.name: Weakened Damage Bonus
140266585.desc: Stinger deals 25% more damage to Weakened enemies.

2686060809.name: Potent Sting
2686060809.desc: Stinger now always deals its damage to surrounding enemies, even if they are not Poisoned. If they were Poisoned, it deals 50%[x] increased damage.

2686060810.name: Unleash the Swarm
2686060810.desc: Stinger spawns 3 Pestilent Swarms that deal 100% damage.

2686060811.name: Nimbostratal Strike
2686060811.desc: Stinger is also an Eagle Skill that deals Lightning damage.  Stinger strikes a small area, dealing 180% damage and creating a Spirit Storm that Sparks enemies for 200% damage. Your other Spirit Storms also deal 180% damage.

1862773.name: Ravager
desc: Active: Unleash a savage roar, causing each of your attacks to trigger an additional {val2}% damage strike per enemy for 6 seconds.

140266582.name: Duration Increase
140266582.desc: Ravager's duration is increased by 2 seconds.

140266583.name: Vigor Generation
140266583.desc: While Ravager is active, gain 50% increased Vigor Generation.

140266584.name: Damage Increase
140266584.desc: Ravager deals 20%[x] increased damage.

140266585.name: Ferocity Maximum
140266585.desc: Ravager's Passive also increases your Maximum Ferocity by 2.

2686060809.name: Carnage
2686060809.desc: Ravager deals 100%[x] increased damage, further increased to 300%[x] against Elites and Bosses.

2686060810.name: Flurry of Claws
2686060810.desc: Ravager's Passive gains: Whenever a Skill comes off Cooldown, deal 80% damage to Close enemies.  While Ravager is active, gain 25% Cooldown Rate.

2686060811.name: Strength of the Forest
2686060811.desc: Ravager is also a Gorilla Skill that deals Physical damage.  Passive: Whenever you gain a stack of Resolve, deal 80% damage around you.  Active: For 6 seconds, casting a Gorilla Skill gives you a stack of Resolve.

1871761.name: Rushing Claw
desc: Slash a short distance through an enemy, striking all enemies along the way twice for a total of {val1}% total damage.

140266582.name: Damage Increase
140266582.desc: Enemies hit by Rushing Claw take 20%[x] increased damage from Rushing Claw, up to 100%[x].

140266583.name: Charge Increase
140266583.desc: Rushing Claw gains 1 Charge.

140266584.name: Damage Bonus
140266584.desc: Rushing Claw deals 60%[x] more damage if you Dodged in the last 5 seconds.

140266585.name: Incarnate Duration
140266585.desc: Rushing Claw extends the duration of your active Incarnate Skills by 0.5 seconds, up to 4.0 seconds.

2686060809.name: Evolving Claws
2686060809.desc: Rushing Claw deals 30% increased damage and is empowered based on how many Charges it has when you Cast it: 1: Heals 15% of your Maximum Life (15). 2: Guaranteed to Critically Strike. 3: Gain 100% Dodge Chance for 1.5 seconds. 4+: Strikes an additional time.  Using Rushing Claw's last Charge will refill 4 Charges by consuming 4 stacks of Ferocity.

2686060810.name: Colossal Claw
2686060810.desc: Rushing Claw now has 12 Maximum Charges. Casting it consumes all Charges to increase its damage by 50%[x] per Charge and it hits a larger area.  Rushing Claw's Cooldown refreshes 10% faster for each Ferocity you have.

2686060811.name: Evasive Swipe
2686060811.desc: Rushing Claw is also an Eagle Skill, deals Lightning damage, and has 2 Charges with a 25 second Charge Cooldown.  You no longer need a target to Cast Rushing Claw.

1871764.name: Armored Hide
desc: Active: Encase yourself, gaining {val2}% Block Chance for 3 seconds.

140266582.name: Blocked Damage Reduction
140266582.desc: While Armored Hide is active, gain 15% Blocked Damage Reduction.

140266583.name: Thorns
140266583.desc: Armored Hide's Passive increases your Thorns by 20%.

140266584.name: Barrier
140266584.desc: Armored Hide also grants a Barrier for 20% of your Maximum Life (20) for 3 seconds.

140266585.name: Duration
140266585.desc: Armored Hide active duration is increased by 1 second.

2686060809.name: Force of Nature
2686060809.desc: Armored Hide restores 50 Vigor and makes you Unstoppable for the duration.

2686060810.name: Trampled Under Foot
2686060810.desc: When you Evade through enemies with Armored Hide active, you deal 300% of your Thorns to them. Activating Armored Hide deals 200% of your Thorns to Close enemies.

2686060811.name: Ferocious Meal
2686060811.desc: Armored Hide is also a Jaguar Skill that deals Fire damage.  Passive: Each time you take damage, gain a stack of Ferocity  Active: Perform large slashes all around you, dealing 125% damage twice. Restore 2% of your Maximum Life each time this damages an enemy. Receive 25% increased Healing for 3.0 seconds.

1871801.name: Scourge
desc: Call forth a wave of insects that bite enemies, Fearing and Slowing them by 70% for 3 seconds while applying {val1}% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds.

140266582.name: Weaken
140266582.desc: Scourge also Weakens enemies for 6 seconds.

140266583.name: Vigor Generation
140266583.desc: Casting Scourge grants 50 Vigor over 6 seconds.

140266584.name: Healing
140266584.desc: Lucky Hit: Hitting an enemy affected by Scourge has up to a 30% chance to Heal you for 5% of your Maximum Life (5).

140266585.name: Vulnerable
140266585.desc: Enemies affected by Scourge are Vulnerable.

2686060809.name: Hive Mind
2686060809.desc: Scourge grants you 15% Damage Reduction and continuously affects enemies around you for 4.5 seconds.

2686060810.name: Scourge Commander
2686060810.desc: Scourge now appears at your target location and deals an extra 80% damage. This amount is increased by 200% against Vulnerable enemies.

2686060811.name: The Beast Within
2686060811.desc: Scourge is also a Gorilla Skill.  Unleash the power of the Gorilla, gaining 348.88 Thorns for each surrounding enemy for 5 seconds and triggering a Thorns attack dealing 200% against them. Repeat this damage every 0.75 seconds for 1.5 seconds.

1871807.name: Razor Wings
desc: Whirl out a cluster of razor sharp feathers that rebound back, dealing {val1}% damage each way.
You can have up to 15 active Razor Wings.

140266582.name: Movement Speed
140266582.desc: For each active Razor Wings, you gain 2%[x] Movement Speed.

140266583.name: Damage Increase
140266583.desc: Razor Wings hits increase your Razor Wings damage by 1%[x] for 4 seconds, stacking up to 30%[x]. Critical Strikes grant 3 stacks.

140266584.name: Refund Charges
140266584.desc: Razor Wings has a 15% chance to regain a Charge when hitting an enemy. Double this chance if you have an active Barrier.

140266585.name: Charge Cooldown
140266585.desc: Razor Wings' Cooldown is 40% longer but it now regains all Charges at once.

2686060809.name: Wing Storm
2686060809.desc: When Razor Wings hits an enemy for the first time, creates a Spirit Storm that Sparks enemies for 150% damage. For each active Spirit Storm, Razor Wings deals 15%[x] increased damage.

2686060810.name: Flock of Feathers
2686060810.desc: Razor Wings last 300% longer and spiral outwards.

2686060811.name: Brutal Blast
2686060811.desc: Razor Wings is also a Gorilla Skill that deals Physical damage.  Razor Wings generates 2 Resolve and fires a slow moving burst of energy that continually pulses, dealing 200% damage every 0.5 seconds.

1871809.name: Touch of Death
desc: Strike an enemy and infect them, dealing {val1}% damage and applying {val2}% Poisoning damage over 9 seconds.
When the infection expires or the host dies, a swarm hatches and seeks enemies for 9 seconds, dealing {val3}% damage per hit.
You can have up to 3 swarms active at once.

140266582.name: Healing
140266582.desc: Touch of Death's infection Heals you for 1.0% of your Maximum Life (1) per second for a total of 9% Maximum Life (9). You Heal any remaining when the swarm hatches.

140266583.name: Weakened Damage
140266583.desc: If Touch of Death's strike hits a Weakened enemy, Touch of Death deals 20%[x] increased damage.

140266584.name: Vulnerable
140266584.desc: Touch of Death makes enemies Vulnerable.

140266585.name: Additional Charge
140266585.desc: Touch of Death gains an additional Charge.

2686060809.name: Erupting Swarm
2686060809.desc: Touch of Death's swarm bursts every second, applying 120% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds to surrounding enemies.

2686060810.name: Swarm of Swarms
2686060810.desc: Touch of Death is also a Core Skill which costs 70 Vigor and has no Cooldown.  When a swarm is replaced early, it bursts for 150% of the damage it would have done.

2686060811.name: Touch of Lightning
2686060811.desc: Touch of Death is also an Eagle Skill that deals Lightning damage.  Touch of Death strikes an enemy, dealing 200% damage and conjuring a Spirit Storm which Sparks enemies for 450% damage. If the enemy dies before the Spirit Storm dissipates, conjure a second moving Spirit Storm.  When you conjure a Spirit Storm, reduce Touch of Death's Cooldown by 1 second.

1871813.name: Toxic Skin
desc: Passive: Enemies that attack you are Poisoned for {val1}% damage over 6 seconds.
Active: Your toxins overflow, applying the Poisoning in a trail and making you Unhindered for 5.0 seconds.

140266582.name: Vigor Generation
