2686060761.desc: Molten Bomb deals up to 40%[x] increased damage based on how far it travels.

2686060762.name: Wrath
2686060762.desc: Molten Bomb generates 1 additional Wrath on each impact.

2686060763.name: Knock Down
2686060763.desc: Molten Bomb has a 15% chance to Knock Down enemies for 2 seconds. When Molten Bomb is empowered by Volatility this chance is increased to 100%. Can occur once every 4 seconds per enemy.

2686060764.name: Area Bonus
2686060764.desc: Molten Bomb's impact area is increased by 30% and does 30%[x] increased damage to enemies at its center.

2686060809.name: Brimstone Mortar
2686060809.desc: Molten Bomb creates a Brimstone at the impact location which deals 56.25% damage when it explodes.

2686060810.name: Demon Turret
2686060810.desc: Molten Bomb becomes a Demonology Summon Skill and creates a turret demon on impact for 5 seconds that spits lava at surrounding enemies, each dealing 48.75% damage. You can have up to 6 turrets active at a once.

2686060811.name: Cluster Bomb
2686060811.desc: Molten Bomb becomes an Abyss Skill and now lobs a cluster of 6 smaller shadow orbs which each deal 33.75% damage. Casting another Molten Bomb splits the previous cluster midflight into a wider impact. If the cluster is not split it instead creates a shadow zone for 7 seconds that grants 4 stacks of Shadowform every second.

2216334.name: Terror Swarm
desc: Summon a terror from the depths that deals {val1}% damage and spews a voracious swarm that deals {val2}% damage per bite for 15 seconds.

289912834.name: Nightmare
289912834.desc: Terror Swarm is now additionally a Recast Skill and stays in place, dealing 260% damage per hit. Recast while active to command the swarm to move to your target.

2686060761.name: Extra Bites
2686060761.desc: Terror Swarm now bites up to 2 additional times per second.

2686060762.name: Vulnerable
2686060762.desc: Terror Swarm makes enemies Vulnerable and causes them to take 40% increased damage from your Archfiend Skills.

2686060763.name: Pull
2686060763.desc: Terror Swarm periodically Pulls enemies into the center of the swarm.

2686060764.name: Lesser Demons
2686060764.desc: Terror Swarm spawns and instantly kills 3 Lesser Demons every second.

2686060810.name: Devouring Swarm
2686060810.desc: Terror Swarm starts smaller and weaker but grows up to 3 times as it feeds on enemies. Upon reaching maximum size, swarms split off another smaller swarm. Can have up to 3 active swarms.

2686060811.name: Searing Infestation
2686060811.desc: Terror Swarm becomes a Hellfire Skill and stays around you, dealing 221% damage per hit.

2218200.name: Umbral Chains
desc: Send forth a shadowy chain, dealing {val1}% damage along the way and linking up to 2 enemies for 5 seconds. Enemies caught in the chain are Slowed by 30% and take {val2}% damage per second.

2686060761.name: Long Range Slow
2686060761.desc: Umbral Chains flies 50% farther and its Slow is increased to 60%.

2686060762.name: Capture Damage
2686060762.desc: Umbral Chains deals 20%[x] increased damage when an unchained enemy is first caught by the chain. Hexed enemies always take increased damage.

2686060763.name: Wrath Refund
2686060763.desc: When Umbral Chains ends it refunds 1 Wrath for every enemy hit over its duration.

2686060764.name: Heavy Harpoon
2686060764.desc: Umbral Chains Knocks Back your primary target and deals 50%[x] increased damage to them.

2686060809.name: Chain Burst
2686060809.desc: Umbral Chains explodes for 93.75% damage when stretched to its maximum or when it expires. If this happens early then any damage the chain would have done is added.

2686060810.name: Epicenter
2686060810.desc: Umbral Chains now always creates a chain link back to you. Additionally, a chain is created between you and each Greater Demon Summon for up to 30 seconds.

2686060811.name: Chain Whips
2686060811.desc: Umbral Chains becomes a Hellfire Skill and whips around your target, dealing 43.75% damage per second to surrounding enemies and striking a 25% larger area when empowered by Volatility.

2218204.name: Doom
desc: Burst a sigil on your enemies, Hexing them and dealing {val1}% damage.

2686060761.name: Damage
2686060761.desc: Doom deals 2%[x] increased damage to enemies for each second they have been Hexed, up to 200%[x].

2686060762.name: Wrath
2686060762.desc: Doom generates 1 Wrath every 2 seconds for each Hexed enemy.

2686060763.name: Assimilation
2686060763.desc: Casting Doom against a Vulnerable, Weakened, or Slowed enemy assimilates the effects, causing Doom to also apply those effects for 3 seconds.

2686060764.name: Echo
2686060764.desc: Casting Doom echoes 10% of its damage to all Nearby Hexed enemies.

2686060809.name: Contagion
2686060809.desc: Whenever you kill a Hexed enemy, Doom spreads the Hex to another enemy and deals 50% damage to them.

2686060810.name: Jailer
2686060810.desc: Doom is cast at range on the ground, leaving behind a mark that Tethers your Primary Target and Hexes enemies within for 6 seconds.

2686060811.name: Doomfire Ritual
2686060811.desc: Doom becomes a Hellfire Skill and your Hex is applied with Maximum Stacks for 15 seconds but you can only have one Hexed target at a time. When Hex expires or is removed, Doom deals 250% damage split amongst all enemies in the area as a Sigil Skill.

2218209.name: Sigil of Subversion
desc: Create a subversive ritual for 10 seconds that Hexes enemies.
Killing 8 enemies or Demons within fuels the ritual to send forth shadow trails for {val1} seconds that periodically grant you 1 stack of Shadowform while in them.
You can have up to 3 trails active at once.

2686060761.name: Movement Speed
2686060761.desc: Sigil of Subversion trails grant you 20%[x] increased Movement Speed while on them.

2686060762.name: Blood Ritual
2686060762.desc: Sacrifice 2% of your Maximum Life to instantly trigger each of Sigil of Subversion's kill costs, up to 48% total.

2686060763.name: Slow
2686060763.desc: Sigil of Subversion trails Slow enemies by 75%.

2686060764.name: Cast Range
2686060764.desc: Sigil of Subversion can now be placed at long range.

2686060809.name: Infiltration Trails
2686060809.desc: Sigil of Subversion trails now last 50% longer and extend away when you near their ends. While within a trail your Shadowform loses no stacks while moving.

2686060810.name: Seekers
2686060810.desc: Sigil of Subversion trails teleport Non-Boss enemies back to the ritual area the first time they come in contact.

2686060811.name: Sigil of Lava
2686060811.desc: Sigil of Subversion becomes a Hellfire Skill and now creates lava trails that periodically deal 35% damage. Enemies that die within the trails have a 35% chance to be charred into Brimstones which deal 200% damage when they explode.

2218211.name: Nether Step
desc: Step through the shadows of Hell to emerge at the target location, gaining 4 stacks of Shadowform as well as 50%[x] increased Movement Speed which decays over {val1} seconds.

2686060761.name: Damage Reduction
2686060761.desc: Nether Step grants 60% Damage Reduction that decays alongside its Movement Speed Bonus.

2686060762.name: Extra Charge
2686060762.desc: Nether Step gains an additional Charge.

2686060763.name: Vacuum Swap
2686060763.desc: Nether Step sucks enemies into its exit portal and swaps places with them.

2686060764.name: Movement Speed
2686060764.desc: Nether Step's Movement Speed Bonus lasts 50% longer.

2686060809.name: Portals
2686060809.desc: Nether Step's portals remain for 10 seconds and can be re-entered to move back and forth.

2686060810.name: Gloomwalker
2686060810.desc: Nether Step now lets you run through the abyss while Immune for up to 3 seconds. Cast again to exit early.

2686060811.name: Shadow Recall
2686060811.desc: Nether Step brings all your Abyss Summons with you through the shadows and extends their durations by 3 seconds.

2218213.name: Sigil of Chaos
desc: Create a destructive ritual for 10 seconds that grants you Volatility while within.
Killing enemies or Demons within fuels the ritual's chaotic hellfire, increasing the chance for each enemy to explode for {val1}% damage on death.

2686060761.name: Volatility Duration
2686060761.desc: Volatility from Sigil of Chaos now lasts for 10 seconds after you leave the area.

2686060762.name: Blood Ritual
2686060762.desc: Sacrifice 4% of your Maximum Life to instantly trigger each of Sigil of Chaos' kill costs, up to 48% total.

2686060763.name: Volatility Casts
2686060763.desc: Volatility empowered casts within Sigil of Chaos count as triggering 3 kills.

2686060764.name: Chain Reaction
2686060764.desc: Hitting an enemy with Sigil of Chaos has a 20% chance to trigger the effect on them again.

2686060809.name: Diabolic Rebuke
2686060809.desc: While you are within Sigil of Chaos, you and your Summons deal 200% damage to enemies when attacked.

2686060810.name: Hellfire Aura
2686060810.desc: Sigil of Chaos is now cast around yourself for 15 seconds and instantly explodes your Lesser Demons within for 40% damage. Cooldown increased to 25 seconds.

2686060811.name: Sigil of Smoke
2686060811.desc: Sigil of Chaos becomes an Abyss Skill and kills within now send out 2 tendrils of abyssal smoke that deal 60% damage and make enemies Vulnerable. The smoke tendrils pierce through Hexed enemies.

2221240.name: Sigil of Summons
desc: Create a binding ritual for 10 seconds that extends the duration of your Summons.
Killing 8 enemies or Demons within fuels the ritual to summon a demon for 20 seconds which attacks nearby enemies, dealing {val1}% damage per hit.
You can have up to 3 demons active at once.

2686060761.name: Damage
2686060761.desc: Enemies within Sigil of Summons take 25%[x] increased damage from your Lesser Demon Skills.

2686060762.name: Blood Ritual
2686060762.desc: Sacrifice 2% of your Maximum Life to instantly pay each of Sigil of Summons' kill costs, up to 48% total.

2686060763.name: Stronger Summons
2686060763.desc: Sigil of Summons deals 25%[x] increased damage but requires 25% more kills per summon.

2686060764.name: Cooldown
2686060764.desc: Sigil of Summons' active Cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds when your Greater Demons die.

2686060809.name: Feeding Frenzy
2686060809.desc: Sigil of Summons now summons up to 2 additional demons. When Sigil of Summons' demons kill enemies they all gain 3% increased Cast Speed, up to 30%

2686060810.name: Summon Succubus
2686060810.desc: Sigil of Summons becomes an Abyss Skill and now requires 12 kills to summon up to 2 dark Succubi which fire Abyssal Bloodstars that Weaken enemies, dealing 96% damage and causing enemies to take an additional 240% damage when they try to attack.

2686060811.name: Summon Hellwyrm
2686060811.desc: Sigil of Summons now requires 16 kills to summon a Hellwyrm Greater Demon that mimics your Lesser Demon Summon Skill casts by regurgitating related Demons which deal 50% of their normal damage.

2221260.name: Apocalypse
desc: Create a massive sigil that detonates after 2.0 seconds dealing {val1}% damage to all enemies within.
This ritual does not benefit from Cooldown Reduction.

2686060761.name: Shared Damage
2686060761.desc: Apocalypse's final hit deals an additional 50% of its damage split amongst all enemies in the area.

2686060762.name: Survivor Damage
2686060762.desc: Enemies that survive Apocalypse take 25%[x] increased damage from you for 3 seconds. This bonus lasts 200% longer against Hexed enemies.

2686060763.name: Double Blast
2686060763.desc: Apocalypse's final hit has a 20% chance to hit twice. When Apocalypse is empowered by Volatility this chance is increased to 100%.

2686060764.name: Epicenter Damage
2686060764.desc: Apocalypse deals up to 25%[x] increased damage the closer enemies are to its center.

2686060809.name: Armageddon Ritual
2686060809.desc: You can now Channel Apocalypse for up to 6.66 seconds to build up the final explosion and rain down Brimstones which deal 666% damage. Each second increases the final damage, up to 666% bonus damage.

2686060810.name: Annihilation
2686060810.desc: Apocalypse launches a hellfire blast with at least 20 Stacks that deals 33.3% damage. Hellfire Skill hits generate up to 100 Stacks, each Stack increases the blast's explosion size and damage by 40%[x].

2686060811.name: Minefield
2686060811.desc: Apocalypse becomes an Abyss Skill, creating a field of Abyssal Mines which arm after 0.8 seconds and each deal 666% damage when an enemy triggers them.

2221282.name: Rampage
desc: Summon a rampaging brute for 10 seconds that smashes wildly, dealing {val1}% damage with a 5% chance per hit to Eviscerate enemies for {val2}% damage.

289912834.name: Abyssal Titan
289912834.desc: Rampage becomes an Abyss Recast Skill and summons a larger demon that deals 50%[x] increased damage. Recast to command the demon to leap around the battlefield, dealing 192% damage with a 15% chance per hit to Knock enemies Down for 3 seconds.

2282617479.name: Demonic Smash
2282617479.desc: Rampage becomes a Hellfire Mobility leap attack that transforms you into Demonform, dealing 290% damage with a 5% chance per hit to grant you Volatility for 10 seconds.

2686060761.name: Killstreak Damage
2686060761.desc: Killing an enemy or Demon with Rampage increases its damage by 20%[x] for 3 seconds, up to 20 seconds.

2686060762.name: Lesser Demon Wrath
2686060762.desc: Casting Rampage compels your Lesser Demon Skills to generate 1.0 Wrath per hit for 5 seconds.

2686060763.name: Elite Hit Chance
2686060763.desc: Rampage has a 100% chance to trigger its Eviscerate, Volatility, or Knockdown hit effect when striking unaffected Elite enemies.

2686060764.name: Demon Masher
2686060764.desc: Rampage now smashes your Lesser Demons to Fortify you for 2% Maximum Life (2).

2686060809.name: Shockwave
2686060809.desc: Each strike from Rampage sends a second smash forward.

2226109.name: Condemn
desc: Harness the Light and Pull enemies in after 1.5 seconds, briefly Stunning them and dealing {val1}% damage.
While Casting Condemn, you become Unhindered for 1.5 seconds.

2686060761.name: Weaken
2686060761.desc: Condemn applies Weaken to enemies for 4 seconds.

2686060762.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060762.desc: Condemn reduces its cooldown by 1 second for each enemy hit, up to 4 seconds.

2686060763.name: Movement Speed
2686060763.desc: Casting Condemn increases your Movement Speed by 30% for 3 seconds.

2686060764.name: Size Increase
2686060764.desc: Condemn's size is increased by 50%.

2686060809.name: Gather the Guilty
2686060809.desc: Condemn now has 1 additional Charge and applies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

2686060810.name: Atonement
2686060810.desc: Condemn Casts significantly faster instead of Pulling enemies in, dealing 420% damage.

2686060811.name: Shepherd the Flock
2686060811.desc: Condemn's build up marks all enemies and drags them to your location after it Casts.

2228435.name: Wall of Agony
desc: Summon and fuse 5 frenzied demons into a line for 8 seconds. The demons block enemies and flail wildly, dealing {val1}% damage per hit to those in front of them.

2686060761.name: Knock Down
2686060761.desc: Each hit from Wall of Agony has a 20% chance to Knock Down enemies for 2 seconds.

2686060762.name: Cost Reduction
2686060762.desc: Wall of Agony's cost is reduced by 50% but increased by 10% for every Demon you have active.

2686060763.name: Damage
2686060763.desc: Wall of Agony deals 2.0%[x] increased damage for every point of Maximum Dominance you have.

2686060764.name: Small Walls
2686060764.desc: Wall of Agony now only spawns 3 demons but its cost is reduced by 50%.

2686060809.name: Fallen Army
2686060809.desc: When Wall of Agony expires, demon brutes remain for 8 seconds and attack Nearby enemies. If Wall of Agony is killed early then the demon brutes gain its remaining duration.

2686060810.name: Waller
2686060810.desc: Wall of Agony summons 10 demons in a cage formation that Pulls enemies inward.

2686060811.name: Encircle
2686060811.desc: Wall of Agony is summoned in an encircling formation that Knocks enemies Back. Each active Wall of Agony demon grants you 6% Damage Reduction, up to 30%. Wall of Agony now has a 20 second Cooldown but costs no Dominance.

2244457.name: Fiend of Abaddon
desc: Summon a massive fiend for 15 seconds that attacks enemies, dealing {val1}% damage per swipe.

289912834.name: Abyssal Colossus
289912834.desc: Fiend of Abaddon becomes an Abyss Recast Skill and now summons a demon for 30 seconds that attacks for 455% damage per swipe. Recast to command the demon to do a massive smash that Pulls in enemies and explodes for 700% damage.

424299000.name: Vanguard of Flames
424299000.desc: Fiend of Abaddon becomes a Hellfire Skill and now summons a demon for 20 seconds that moves with you and attacks for 630% damage per swipe.

2686060761.name: Crowd Damage
2686060761.desc: Fiend of Abaddon deals 2%[x] increased damage for each Nearby enemy present when it is summoned, up to 60%[x].

2686060762.name: Lesser Demon Bonus
2686060762.desc: Each active Fiend of Abaddon increases your Lesser Demon Skill damage by 30%[x].

2686060763.name: Elite Damage
2686060763.desc: Fiend of Abaddon deals 25%[x] increased damage against Elite enemies and Bosses.

2686060764.name: Dominance
2686060764.desc: Fiend of Abaddon now costs 30 Dominance and has no Cooldown.

2686060809.name: Spiteful Enrage
2686060809.desc: If an enemy survives more than 5 hits from Fiend of Abaddon then each subsequent hit increases its damage versus that target by 5%[x] and extends its lifetime by 2 seconds, up to 60 seconds.

2245719.name: Bombardment
desc: Smash down 4 demons into the ground, each dealing {val1}% damage.

2686060761.name: Damage
2686060761.desc: Each cast of Bombardment deals 5% increased damage to each enemy per hit.

2686060762.name: Additional Demon
2686060762.desc: Bombardment throws 1 additional demon.

2686060763.name: Telekinesis
2686060763.desc: Each time Bombardment throws a demon it has a 100% chance to also throw a surrounding Lesser Demon at your target location.

2686060764.name: Focused Target
2686060764.desc: Bombardment's chaotic spread is reduced by 300% and it deals 30% increased damage when only hitting a single enemy.

2686060809.name: Brutality
2686060809.desc: Each cast of Bombardment within 3 seconds of the last calls down more demons, up to 4 additional.

2686060810.name: Demon Mangler
2686060810.desc: Each Bombardment impact now has a 40% chance to leave behind mutilated demons for 8 seconds that attack surrounding enemies, dealing 27.5% damage.

2686060811.name: Endless Barrage
2686060811.desc: Bombardment becomes a Hellfire Skill and now only slams down demons randomly around yourself but demons continue to rain down around you for 10 seconds afterward. This effect can stack up to 5 times.

2245730.name: Tortured Wretch
desc: Summon a tortured demon on your enemies, dealing {val1}% damage and Taunting them to attack it for 5 seconds.

2686060761.name: Unstoppable
2686060761.desc: Casting Tortured Wretch makes you Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

2686060762.name: Cost Reduction
2686060762.desc: Tortured Wretch cost is reduced by 30%.

2686060763.name: Enrage
2686060763.desc: When enemies attack the Tortured Wretch they are enraged for 2 seconds, gaining 100% increased Attack Speed but taking 25% damage when they hit targets.

2686060764.name: Duration
2686060764.desc: Enemies and Demons killed Close to the Tortured Wretch extend its duration by 0.5 seconds, up to 5 seconds.

2686060809.name: Death Saws
2686060809.desc: Saws grind up enemies around the Tortured Wretch, periodically dealing 20% damage with a 5% chance to Eviscerate enemies for 600% damage.

2686060810.name: Punching Bag
2686060810.desc: Tortured Wretch no longer Taunts but now lasts for 12 seconds and you redirect all damage to it so long as you stay in the area. It can absorb up to 30% of your Maximum Life before it is killed. When the demon dies it explodes, dealing up to 500% damage and Fortifying you for up to 25% based on the damage it absorbed.

2686060811.name: Domination
2686060811.desc: Tortured Wretch becomes an Abyss Occult Recast Skill and now directly dominates a target's mind for up to 15 seconds, forcing it to Taunt your enemies and take 50% damage when hit by them. Recast to command the target around the battlefield.

2261380.name: Purify
desc: Enshroud your enemies in the Light, Dazing them for {val1} seconds.

2686060761.name: Faith Generation
2686060761.desc: Purify generates 10 Faith for each enemy it hits.

2686060762.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060762.desc: Purify reduces its cooldown by 1 second per enemy it hits up to 3 seconds.

2686060763.name: Echo
2686060763.desc: Purify echoes 2 additional times outward from where it is Cast.

2686060764.name: Size Bonus
2686060764.desc: Increase the size of Purify by 50%.

2686060809.name: Sentence
2686060809.desc: Purify also Judges enemies and its cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.

2686060810.name: Surrender
2686060810.desc: Instead of Dazing enemies, Purify now Stuns for 4 seconds.

2686060811.name: Absolution
2686060811.desc: Purify now can be cast on enemies. Instead of Dazing them, it deals 380% damage and makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

2265693.name: Brandish
desc: Brandish the Light, unleashing an arc that deals {val1}% damage.

2686060761.name: Cast Speed
2686060761.desc: Brandish has 20% increased Cast Speed.

2686060762.name: Damage Increase
2686060762.desc: Brandish deals 20%[x] increased damage

2686060763.name: Vulnerable
2686060763.desc: Brandish applies Vulnerable to enemies for 4 seconds.

2686060764.name: Faith Generation
2686060764.desc: Brandish generates 5 additional Faith.

2686060809.name: Cross Strike
2686060809.desc: Brandish unleashes 2 additional arcs, dealing 120% damage.

2686060810.name: Sword of Mastery
2686060810.desc: While Healthy, Brandish deals 127.5% damage and travels 100% faster.

2686060811.name: Returning Light
2686060811.desc: Brandish's light returns to you, dealing 52.5% damage on its return.

2273081.name: Heaven's Fury
desc: Grasp the Light, dealing 200% damage around you per second before releasing it to seek Nearby enemies and dealing {val1}% damage per hit for 7 seconds.

2686060761.name: Judgement
2686060761.desc: Heaven's Fury's light Judges enemies.

2686060762.name: Damage Bonus
2686060762.desc: Enemies hit by Heaven's Fury take 20% increased damage from Heaven's Fury forever.

2686060763.name: Slow
2686060763.desc: Heaven's Fury Slows enemies by 50% for 5 seconds.

2686060764.name: Duration
2686060764.desc: Increase Heaven's Fury duration by 4 seconds.

2686060809.name: Triplicate
2686060809.desc: Heaven's Fury splits into 3 beams, dealing 57% damage each hit for 7 seconds.

2686060810.name: Walk With The Light
2686060810.desc: Heaven's Fury splits into 5 orbiting beams, dealing 78% damage each hit for 7 seconds.

2686060811.name: Final Justice
2686060811.desc: Heaven's Fury can Cast anywhere, concentrating the Light as it grows and Pulls enemies in while dealing 105% damage per second before erupting for 1,260% damage.  Heaven's Fury's Cooldown is increased by 10 seconds.

2283781.name: Consecration
desc: Bathe in the Light for 6 seconds, Healing you and your allies for {val1}% Maximum Life ({val2}) per second and damaging enemies for {val3}% damage per second.

2686060761.name: Weaken
2686060761.desc: Consecration Weakens enemies within.

2686060762.name: Duration
2686060762.desc: Increase the duration of Consecration by 35%[x].

2686060763.name: Fortify
2686060763.desc: Consecration's initial Cast Fortifies you for 0.5% of Maximum Life (1) per enemy hit.

2686060764.name: Resource Generation
2686060764.desc: Consecration increases Primary Resource Generation for you and your allies by 10%.

2686060809.name: Hallowed Ground
2686060809.desc: Consecration's size is increased by 56%  While inside Consecration, you and your allies deal 7%[x] additional damage and consume 15%[x] less resource.

2686060810.name: Bastion
2686060810.desc: Consecration Immobilizes enemies and can be cast anywhere.

2686060811.name: Sanctify
2686060811.desc: Consecration lasts 3 seconds, increasing its damage and Healing by 20% each second.  Consecration detonates when it expires, dealing 90% damage to all enemies and Healing you and your allies for 15% of their Maximum Life (15).

2289261.name: Profane Sentinel
desc: Summon a demonic eye for 15 seconds that focuses upon enemies with a beam that makes them Vulnerable and periodically blasts them, dealing {val1}% damage. Recast to direct the eye's targeting.

2282617479.name: Demonic Sight
2282617479.desc: Profane Sentinel becomes a Hellfire eye blast attack that transforms you into Demonform, dealing 414% damage and Weakening enemies.

2686060761.name: Single Target Damage
2686060761.desc: Profane Sentinel deals 30%[x] increased damage when it only hits a single target.

2686060762.name: Lesser Demon Vulnerable
2686060762.desc: Casting Profane Sentinel induces your Lesser Demon Skills to make enemies Vulnerable for 5 seconds.

2686060763.name: Narrow Blast
2686060763.desc: Profane Sentinel deals 25%[x] increased damage but its blast area is reduced by 50%.

2686060764.name: Wide Beam
2686060764.desc: Profane Sentinel's beam area is 200% larger.

2686060809.name: Focused Glare
2686060809.desc: The longer Profane Sentinel is locked onto the same enemy the stronger it becomes, dealing 25% more damage every second.

2686060810.name: Sentry
2686060810.desc: You can now summon multiple Profane Sentinels but can no longer redirect their gaze. Profane Sentinels deal 126% damage and fire extra blasts at any Nearby Stealthed enemies.

2292204.name: Aegis
desc: Surround yourself with shields of the Light, Taunting Close enemies and gaining {val1}% Block Chance and {val2}% Armor for 4 seconds.

2686060761.name: Unstoppable
2686060761.desc: Casting Aegis grants Unstoppable for 4 seconds.

2686060762.name: Block Damage Reduction
2686060762.desc: Casting Aegis increases your Block Damage Reduction by 15% while active.

2686060763.name: Duration
2686060763.desc: Increase Aegis's duration by 4.

2686060764.name: Cooldown Reduction
2686060764.desc: Reduce Aegis's cooldown by 4 seconds.

2686060809.name: Stay Resolute
2686060809.desc: Passive: Gaining or spending Resolve has a 4% chance to trigger a free Aegis.  Casting Aegis grants 8 stacks of Resolve.

2686060810.name: Faith Is My Shield
2686060810.desc: Aegis now applies Judgement instead of Taunting enemies.  Blocking while Aegis is active applies Judgement to the attacker.

2686060811.name: Impunity
2686060811.desc: While Aegis is active, you gain 40% Thorns and Retribution Chance.

2297097.name: Holy Light Aura
desc: Passive: You and your allies emanate the Light, dealing {val1}% damage every 2 seconds to 3 random Nearby enemies. Attack Speed further increases this damage.

Active: Unleash 2 pure bolts of light, dealing {val2}% Holy damage to the Closest enemy and chaining up to 4 additional enemies before returning to you. When your first bolt of light returns, Heal for 12% of your Maximum Life (12).

2686060761.name: Additional Targets
2686060761.desc: Holy Light Aura's passive now targets 1 additional enemies.

2686060762.name: Additional Bounce
2686060762.desc: Holy Light Aura's active bounces 1 additional time.

2686060763.name: Potency
2686060763.desc: Holy Light Aura gains 15% more bonus from potency.

2686060764.name: Judgement Damage Bonus
2686060764.desc: Holy Light Aura's deals 40%[x] increased damage against enemies affected by Judgement.

2686060809.name: Rite of Judgement
2686060809.desc: Holy Light's active also Judges enemies and its Cooldown is reduced per rank.

Colossal further increases Skill size to 50%, and damage to 600%[x].
Berserking's damage bonus is increased by 50% and it also grants 20% Cast Speed.
Gain 30% Damage Reduction while Berserking.
You gain stacking bonuses the longer you stay Berserking:
5 seconds - 200%[x] Damage and 30% Fury Cost Reduction.
10 seconds - 10 Fury Per Second and 10% Cooldown Reduction.
20 seconds - Every 5 seconds, trigger a random Shout Skill.
60 seconds - 10%[x] increased damage against Elites.
Casting Skills that swapped weapons deal 100%[x] increased damage and reduce your Weapon Mastery Cooldowns by 5 seconds.
Swapping weapons grants 2 Resolve and a Barrier for 10% of your Maximum Life, up to 100%, for 6 seconds.
Swapping weapons grants 50%[x] increased damage for 6 seconds, stacking up to 150%[x], and also triggers an equipped Non-Ultimate Weapon Mastery Skill.
Your Bleeding effects last 80%[x] longer and make enemies Vulnerable.
Gain 30% Maximum Life and 500 Life on Hit.
Casting a skill that applies Bleeding to enemies has 10% chance to Rupture them for 200%[x] increased damage. Enemies take 200%[x] increased Bleeding damage.
Ancient Skills cost 50% reduced Fury, gain 50% increased Cooldown Reduction, and deal 50%[x] increased damage.
Summoning an Ancient grants 5% Damage Reduction for 10 seconds, up to 30%.
When Summoning an Ancient, Summon 1 additional Ancient. Ancient Skills deal 200%[x] increased damage.

Storm Skills no longer cost Spirit to cast. Casting a Storm Skill consumes all available Spirit to increase Storm Skill damage by 0.25 per Spirit consumed, cumulatively stacking up to 80%[x] for 4 seconds.
Gain Cyclone Armor for free.
Cyclone Armor grants 30%[x] Damage Reduction and triggers when Close enemies damage you. This effect can only happen once every 10 seconds, affected by Cooldown Reduction.
Storm Skills deal 100%[x] increased damage and have a 20% chance to Double Cast and a 5% chance to Triple Cast. Double and Triple Casts gain a 350%[x] damage bonus.

Your Earth Skills Fossilize enemies, reducing their movement speed by 15% and increasing the damage they take from you by 15%[x] for 4 seconds. Enemies become Fossilized at 4 stacks, Petrifying them for 3 seconds. Petrified enemies are Stunned and take 100%[x] bonus Critical Strike Damage.
Fossilizing enemies grants 30% Damage Reduction for 15 seconds.
Petrified enemies absorb your damage dealt and will explode for 200% of the amount absorbed when Petrify expires or if the absorbed damage exceeds the target's remaining Life.
Dealing damage in Werebear form grants 1 stack of Stoicism, (2 while Berserking) which increases your damage by 4%. Stacks up to 20 times and you lose a stack when taking direct damage.
Increases your Damage Reduction while in Werebear form by 25% and an additional 10% while Berserking.

At 20 stacks of Stoicism, you explode in a feral Rampage until you fall below 15 stacks. While Rampaging, you grow larger allowing your Werebear Skills to deal 225%[x] bonus damage. In addition, Rampaging allows you to move Unhindered through enemies Knocking them Down.

Talisman_Druid_04.name: Rush of the Red Wolf Moon

d: While in Werewolf form, you periodically smell dread in enemies, marking them. Your Werewolf Skills deal 60%[x] bonus damage. Attacking a marked enemy grants you 1 seconds of Blood Hunt, increasing your Movement Speed and Attack Speed by 20%[x]. Killing a marked enemy instead grants 2 seconds.
Gain 20%[x] Damage Reduction while in Werewolf form.
You heal for 70% of any damage taken over 3 seconds.

When Blood Hunt exceeds 20 seconds, you explode in a Feral Rage for 10 seconds, increasing your Movement Speed and Cast Speed by 25%[x] and allowing all of your Werewolf Skills to dash you towards your target and dealing 250%[x] bonus damage. Killing enemies extends the duration of Feral Rage by 1 second.
Summon a Bear Companion that attacks enemies for 150 damage and may cast Battle Roar increasing the damage of all Companions by 90%[x] for 10 seconds. (5 second cooldown)
30% of the damage you take is split between you and your Bear Companion. When you or your Bear Companion becomes Injured, your Bear Companion casts Debilitating Roar on enemies and fully heals.
Gain 1 additional Bear and all other Companions of each type.
Gain 250%[x] increased Companion damage and all Companion Upgrades for free.

When you Cast a Marksman Basic Skill, you gain a stack of Vengeance, which grants 3% increased Movement Speed and 15%[x] increased damage for your Marksman Skills. Vengeance stacks up to 5 times and loses 1 stack every 4 seconds.
While you have Vengeance, you gain 1 Dark Shroud shadow every 2 seconds, 30% Damage Reduction whenever you have at least 1 shadow, and Knockback Close enemies when you lose a shadow.
While you have Vengeance, your Marksman Skills deal 200%[x] increased damage and you trigger the last Marksman Basic Skill you used 3 times whenever you Cast a Marksman Skill at a targeted enemy.
Cutthroat Skills deal 60%[x] increased damage.
Stabbing an enemy in the back with a Cutthroat Skill deals 10%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage.
Casting an Agility Skill grants you 30% Damage Reduction for 8 seconds and Slows Nearby enemy Small Missiles by 80% for 4 seconds.

After stabbing an enemy in the back or Critically Striking an enemy, your senses heighten, allowing all your hits to count as backstabs and granting 40%[x] increased Cast Speed and 250%[x] increased damage for 4 seconds.
Cutthroat Skill backstabs have a 10% chance to make your next Agility Skill free to Cast, up to a maximum of 3.
Your Grenade and Trap Skills deal 60%[x] increased damage.
Casting a Grenade or Trap Skill reduces the active Cooldown of your Grenade and Trap Skills by 1 second.
Gain 5% Damage Reduction for every Grenade or Trap Skill Casted within the last 12 seconds, up to 30%.

Casting a Grenade or Trap Skill triggers a cluster of exploding Stun Grenades that deal 300 total Physical damage and Stun enemies for 1.00 second. Enemies hit by Stun Grenades take 250%[x] increased damage from your Grenade and Trap Skills for 6 seconds.
Lucky Hit: Imbued Skills have up to a 50% chance to activate Inner Sight.
While Inner Sight is active, Imbueable Skills are Shadow Imbued by default.
Imbued Skills deal 60% increased damage.
Automatically drink a free Healing Potion every 4 seconds.
Drinking a Healing Potion increases your Maximum Life by 30% for 8 seconds.
Your Imbuements gain all Upgrades for free, their potency is increased by 200%[x], and grant 50% Lucky Hit Chance while active.
While Inner Sight is active, your Imbueable Skills apply all Imbuements.
Entering Stealth reduces any of your Ultimate Skills' active Cooldowns by 6 seconds and breaking Stealth grants 60%[x] increased damage for 6 seconds.
Using an Ultimate Skill resets Concealment's Cooldown.
Concealment gains all Upgrades for free and also grants 60% Damage Reduction while active and then 30% for 6 seconds after.
Gain a permanent Shadow Clone, which can now also Cast Death Trap and Rain of Arrows.
Breaking Stealth now grants an additional 250%[x] increased damage.
Forming or consuming a Corpse reduces the Essence costs and Cooldowns of your Profane and Macabre Skills by 25% and increases their damage by 50%[x] for 6 seconds.
Casting an Ultimate Skill forms 10 Corpses over its duration.
When you form or consume a Corpse you gain 15% Damage Reduction for 6 seconds.
Enemies Close to your Corpses are inflicted with Decrepify and Iron Maiden.
Your Profane and Macabre Skills deal 250%[x] increased damage.
Your Ultimate Skills are also Profane or Macabre Skills.
After spending 100 Essence on Bone Skills you gain Quintessence for 15 seconds. Quintessence increases your Critical Strike Chance by 10% and your Critical Strike Damage by 50%[x].
Quintessence also grants 30% Damage Reduction.

Whenever you gain Quintessence you spray out 12 piercing bone shards in all directions, dealing 750 damage each, generating 3 Essence per enemy hit, and causing enemies hit to take 200%[x] increased damage from your Bone Skills.
Your Blood Skills Fortify you for 5% of your Maximum Life on cast and deal 60%[x] increased damage while Fortify is actively healing you.
Every percentage of Fortified Life you gain also increases your Maximum Life by an equal percentage for 20 seconds, up to 50%.
Your Basic, Core, and Ultimate Blood Skills drain 3% of your Maximum Life on Cast to trigger twice. Your Blood Skills deal 100%[x] increased damage.
Your Darkness Skills deal 75% of their damage as additional Corrupting or Frostbite damage over 10 seconds.
You gain 30% Damage Reduction for 5 seconds whenever you deal damage over time to an enemy.
You deal 175%[x] increased Shadow and Cold damage.
Enemies who are Corrupted or Frostbitten for more than their remaining life are permanently Vulnerable, Weakened, Slowed by 85%, take 50%[x] increased damage from you, and are Feared every 5 seconds.
Gain 60%[x] increased Summoning damage. Each time your Minions deal direct damage, reduce the Cooldown of Army of the Dead by 0.25 seconds.
35% of the damage you take is redirected to your Minions.
Gain 200%[x] Summoning damage.
While Army of the Dead is active, your Minions are larger, have 100%[x] increased Life, and gain 25% Attack Speed.
Your Poisoning effects last 80%[x] longer and Weaken enemies.
Gain 40% Maximum Life.
Dealing Poisoning damage has a 10% chance to Heal you for 5% of your Maximum Life.
Every 6 seconds, a Non-Boss enemy who you Poisoned for more than their remaining Life is killed instantly and unleashes Scourge. Scourge increases your Poison damage by 250%[x] for 10 seconds.
Gain 10000 Thorns.
Gain 60%[x] increased Thorns.
Blocking an attack has a 20% chance to pulse your Thorns around you. This damage counts as a Gorilla Skill.
Gain 30% Block Chance and 25% Damage Reduction.
Your Gorilla Skills deal 150%[x] increased damage.
Gain the Gorilla Primary Spirit Hall bonus for free with 250% potency.

Dealing direct damage to enemies 65 times grants Prowess for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times, but does not refresh at 5 stacks. Jaguar Skills gain 5% Cast Speed and 10%[x] Critical Strike Damage per stack.
Gain 5% Dodge Chance and 5% Damage Reduction per stack of Prowess.

Prowess now lasts 8 seconds, can be refreshed, and its bonuses are increased by 25%. While you have 5 stacks of Prowess, your Ferocity is overfilled by 2 and your Jaguar Skills deal 25%[x] increased damage per Ferocity you have.
Moving 15 meters increases your Eagle Skill damage by 50%[x] for 8 seconds and reduces your Eagle Skills' active Cooldowns by 2 seconds.
Gain 30% Damage Reduction while moving and for 1.5 seconds after.
Gain 35% Movement Speed.
Your Eagle Skills deal 200%[x] increased damage while moving and for 1.5 seconds after.
While you have an Ultimate Skill active, your Skills gain that Ultimate's Spirit type.
Your Skills deal 20%[x] increased damage per Spirit type they have.
Casting a Skill grants you 70% Resistance to its Spirit's primary damage type and gain the Passive effect of that Spirit's Incarnate Skill for 10 seconds.
Casting a Skill has a 5% chance to invoke the Ultimate Spirit of that Skill's type and increase your damage from that Spirit by 50%[x] for 10 seconds.
+5% Damage Reduction
x10%[x] Damage
+10% Damage Reduction from Elites
x15%[x] Damage to Elites
+5% Attack Speed
+15% Movement Speed
+25% Gold Find
+50% Bonus Kill Experience (5% at level 70)
+1000 Armor
+100 All Resistances
+200 All Stats
Lucky Hit: Up to a 40% chance to deal 1500 Cold damage
Lucky Hit: Up to a 40% chance to deal 1500 Fire damage
Lucky Hit: Up to a 40% chance to deal 1500 Lightning damage
+2 to All Skills
Enemies cower before you, becoming Feared and Immobilized for 0.5 seconds when they first see you or when you Block them.
You reflect Stun and Knockback effects.
Your Minimum Resolve is increased by 2 and Maximum Resolve is increased by 2 and you gain 10% Damage Reduction for each Minimum Resolve you have.
When you try to Crowd Control a worthy enemy, one that can't be Crowd Controlled, you rise to the occasion gaining 500%[x] increased damage for 15 seconds.
Casting Zealot Skills grants Do or Die on hit, increasing your Critical Strike damage by 2.5%[x] and Cast Speed by 0.4% for 2 seconds, stacking up to 25 times.
Do or Die automatically triggers Rally every 6 seconds while at maximum stacks.
Rally additionally grants 30% increased Damage Reduction.
Zealot Skills deal 200%[x] increased damage.
Every 5 Stacks of Do or Die stores a Zealot Afterimage. Moving periodically spawns your stored Afterimages.
Judgement now spreads to targets that don't have it and Judging enemies grants Judgement Day, increasing your damage by 12.5%[x] for 10 seconds, up to 5 times.
You gain 30% Damage Reduction and Heal for 3% of your Maximum Life every second while affected by Judgement Day.
Judgement Day's damage bonus is increased to 25%[x] and its maximum number of stacks is increased to 20. Judging a Boss grants 5 stacks of Judgement Day.
Disciple Skills reduce the Cooldown of Arbiter of Justice by 0.1 seconds when they deal damage, or by 0.5 seconds if they have a Cooldown.
While in Arbiter, gain 30% increased Maximum Life and 10%[x] increased Movement Speed
When you Cast Arbiter of Justice, unleash all Ultimates, triggering Heaven's Fury and Fortress and replacing Arbiter of Justice with Zenith for 10 seconds.
Gain 500%[x] increased damage with Disciple Skills for the duration of Arbiter of Justice.
All Ultimates are also Disciple Skills.
Gain 55% Aura Potency.
You gain 30% Damage Reduction.
Your Auras Skills gain all of their Variants and Upgrades.
Your Auras Skills actives no longer take Faith to Cast.
Gain Conviction Aura, increasing the damage Nearby enemies take from all sources by 0.5%[x] per Skill Rank you have in all your Aura Skills.

Gain Sadism for 20 seconds as your demons take damage or die, increasing the damage your demons take by 2% per stack. You deal up to 200% more damage to enemies based on how much damage they have done to your demons.
Sadism sends 2% of the damage you take to each of your demons. Sadism additionally increases enemy aggression towards your demons.
Sadism increases your Demonology Skill damage by 2% per stack. Killing enemies while at max Sadism has a 25% chance to twist them into one of your equipped  Lesser Demon Summons.

While in Demonform quickly gain Infernal Hunger stacks, each increasing the damage you take by 0.5%. Killing enemies and Demons or hitting Elites converts Infernal Hunger stacks into Demonic Strength, each granting 2%[x] increased Damage for 20 seconds.
Demonform increases your Maximum Life by 20%, each stack of Demonic Strength grants 0.55% additional Maximum Life.

Demonic Strength's bonuses are increased by 150% and now persist after you leave Demonform. While you have Volatility, your Hellfire Skill damage is increased by 66%[x] and you gain Infernal Hunger twice as fast.
Enemies within Shadowform areas are Dominated for up to 7.0 seconds, preventing them from acting and causing them to move where you target with Recast Skills.
Shadowform reduces damage taken by 25% and leaves Sigil of Subversion shadow trails behind you while moving.
Your Abyss Skill damage is increased by 350%[x] while you have Shadowform but each cast consumes 1 stack. Dominated enemies and Staggered Bosses take an additional 100%[x] damage.

Casting a Sigil Skill begins a Ritual for 60 seconds that grants 100%[x] damage which intensifies up to 200%[x] as the Ritual nears its end. Completing Sigils progresses the Ritual by 6 seconds and when the timer ends your next Sigil Skill unleashes the Power Within, making your Occult Skills free to cast for 6 seconds.
The Ritual grants 20% Damage Reduction that intensifies with the Ritual up to 40%.
Casting a Sigil Skill now creates all Base Sigil Skills at once. You deal 200%[x] increased damage to enemies in Base Sigil Skills, doubled while the Power Within is unleashed.
Gain a bonus per active Soul Shard demon:
Ae'grom: 10%[x] increased Damage per active Greater Demon Summon
Abodian: 25% increased Movement Speed and Attack Speed
Laalish: Attacks Execute enemies
Valloch: 50% increased Dominance Generation
Gain 8.5% Damage Reduction for each active Soul Shard demon.
Gain all Soul Shard demons and deal 200%[x] increased Damage for 20 seconds after casting a Soul Shard Skill. All Soul Shard Skill costs are reduced by 35%.
